agrega este prompt a public/webPages/web-pages.json:
Tour 3D elegante del campus corporativo con videos explicativos
Entregables
* index.html, styles.css, app.js, carpeta assets/ con modelos GLB, texturas HDR, videos MP4, locuciones y subtítulos SRT.
Stack sugerido
* Three.js (CDN), GSAP para transiciones, video HTML5 como texturas, Draco para compresión GLB, IntersectionObserver para lazy‑load.
Descripción (FAQ)
¿Cuál es el objetivo de esta experiencia?
Crear un tour 3D elegante que presente la sede corporativa como un entorno inmersivo. El visitante puede explorar zonas (recepción, auditorio, I+D) y, al activar un hotspot, reproducir un video explicativo de 30–90 segundos que contextualiza la función del área, con locución y subtítulos en varios idiomas.
¿Cómo se estructura la escena 3D?
La escena contiene un modelo GLB del edificio dividido en nodos semánticos (p. ej., lobby, auditorio, lab). Cada nodo tiene un hotspot 3D (esfera translúcida) con aria-label. La cámara inicia en una vista amplia y ofrece vistas predefinidas (1: Lobby, 2: Auditorio, 3: Terraza) accesibles por teclado.
¿Qué sucede al activar un hotspot?
1. La cámara realiza un fly‑to suave con easing cinematográfico (GSAP).
2. Se carga y reproduce un video en un panel HTML superpuesto (o como textura en un plano 3D si el usuario lo prefiere).
3. Se muestran subtítulos SRT sincronizados y una transcripción descargable.
4. El hotspot muestra métricas animadas en 3D (capacidad, proyectos, años).
¿Cómo se manejan interacciones y controles?
* Drag para rotar, scroll/pinch para zoom, teclado para vistas rápidas.
* Controles táctiles optimizados: doble toque para centrar, gesto de dos dedos para zoom.
* Botón “Iniciar tour” que reproduce una narración completa y guía automática por hotspots.
¿Qué videos y formatos se usan?
* Videos H.264 MP4 720p para web; opcional 1080p para desktop.
* Cada video incluye SRT y metadatos JSON (duración, idioma, locutor).
* Videos pre‑cargados de forma progresiva: primero thumbnails, luego streaming adaptativo si es necesario.
¿Cómo se garantiza rendimiento y carga?
* Draco para modelos; texturas 512–1024 px; lazy‑load de videos y modelos por sección.
* Render loop pausado cuando canvas fuera de viewport (IntersectionObserver).
* LOD para modelos y reducción de draw calls; requestAnimationFrame optimizado.
¿Qué accesibilidad y fallbacks se implementan?
* prefers-reduced-motion reduce o desactiva fly‑to y partículas.
* Alternativa 2D: video hero con navegación por capítulos y transcripción completa.
* Todos los hotspots tienen aria-label y el panel de video usa role="dialog" con aria-modal.
¿Qué pruebas y métricas se recomiendan?
* Probar en Chrome, Safari iOS, Firefox; medir FPS y TTFB.
* Registrar eventos: hotspots activados, videos reproducidos, tiempo de visualización.
* A/B test de autoplay del tour vs. control manual.

agrega este prompt a public/webPages/web-pages.json:
— Galería 3D de productos de lujo con proyección de video y microinteracciones
Entregables
* index.html, styles.css, gallery.js, assets/ con modelos GLB, videos promocionales, HDRI y sprites.
Stack sugerido
* Three.js, video textures, PBR materials, GSAP para easing, LazySizes para imágenes.
Descripción (FAQ)
¿Qué experiencia debe ofrecer la galería?
Una vitrina 3D por producto con acabado premium: cada vitrina es un pedestal con iluminación suave y una pantalla integrada que reproduce un video promocional cuando el usuario se acerca. La estética es minimalista, paleta neutra y tipografía serif para títulos.
¿Cómo se detecta la proximidad del usuario?
Se calcula la distancia entre la cámara y el centro de la vitrina; al cruzar un umbral (ej. 3.5 m) se activa una transición: la vitrina se ilumina, el material gana un sutil bloom y el video comienza con fade‑in.
¿Cómo se integran los videos en la escena?
* Videos MP4 se usan como texturas en un plano 3D dentro de la vitrina.
* Alternativa: panel HTML superpuesto sincronizado con la vitrina para accesibilidad.
* Subtítulos SRT renderizados en HTML para legibilidad y búsqueda.
¿Qué microinteracciones se requieren?
* Hover/Focus: pedestal eleva 6–10px y aplica box-shadow suave.
* Click: vitrina se abre (animación 3D) y muestra ficha técnica con specs y un clip extendido.
* Drag: rotación del producto con inercia; doble‑tap para vista macro.
¿Cómo se manejan assets y rendimiento?
* Modelos GLB optimizados con LOD; texturas PBR 1024 px.
* Videos 720p con preload="metadata" y streaming adaptativo si disponible.
* Pausar videos fuera de viewport y liberar texturas cuando no se usan.
¿Qué consideraciones de accesibilidad?
* Panel HTML con controles de video nativos y aria-describedby.
* Subtítulos y transcripciones; descripciones alternativas para imágenes.
* prefers-reduced-motion reduce animaciones y desactiva rotaciones automáticas.
¿Cómo se organiza la navegación y búsqueda?
* Barra lateral con filtros (colección, material, año).
* Al aplicar filtro, las vitrinas se reordenan con animación 3D suave.
* Breadcrumbs y deep links para compartir una vitrina específica.
¿Qué métricas y analítica se deben capturar?
* Reproducciones de video, tiempo medio de visualización, interacciones de rotación, clicks en “Ver ficha”.
* Heatmaps de cámara para identificar vitrinas más exploradas.

agrega este prompt a public/webPages/web-pages.json:
Aula 3D elegante con lecciones en video sincronizadas y ejercicios interactivos
Entregables
* index.html, styles.css, classroom.js, assets/ con videos de lecciones, modelos 3D de instrumentos y datasets.
Stack sugerido
* A-Frame o Three.js, video HTML5, WebAudio API, GSAP y Web Workers para cálculos.
Descripción (FAQ)
¿Cuál es la finalidad educativa de esta aula 3D?
Ofrecer lecciones multimedia donde cada módulo combina un video tutorial con una simulación 3D sincronizada. Por ejemplo, en una lección de física el video explica un experimento y la simulación 3D reproduce exactamente los pasos, permitiendo al alumno pausar, scrubbing y modificar parámetros en tiempo real.
¿Cómo se sincroniza video y simulación?
* El video actúa como master clock; la simulación escucha eventos de tiempo (timeupdate) y aplica estados predefinidos (posiciones, fuerzas) en momentos clave.
* Se usa GSAP Timeline para coordinar animaciones 3D con marcadores del video (capítulos).
* El usuario puede scrubbear el video y la simulación retrocede/avanza frame‑a‑frame.
¿Qué tipos de ejercicios interactivos se incluyen?
* Sandbox: cambiar variables (masa, fricción) y ver resultados en tiempo real.
* Desafío: completar una tarea en un tiempo límite; al finalizar se reproduce un video de solución con explicación.
* Comparador: ejecutar dos configuraciones lado a lado con videos sincronizados.
¿Cómo se presentan los videos?
* Clips segmentados (30–120s) con SRT y transcripciones.
* Opción de ver la lección completa en fullscreen con overlay de notas y preguntas.
* Videos optimizados para streaming y con playsinline en móviles.
¿Qué controles y accesibilidad se implementan?
* Subtítulos y transcripciones descargables.
* Controles de velocidad (0.5x, 1x, 1.5x) que afectan también la simulación.
* prefers-reduced-motion reduce animaciones y ofrece versión estática con gráficos.
¿Cómo se asegura la precisión y reproducibilidad?
* Simulaciones deterministas con semilla fija; export de parámetros en JSON para reproducir sesiones.
* Registro de interacciones para reproducir la sesión del alumno y generar feedback automatizado.
¿Qué consideraciones de rendimiento y escalabilidad?
* Cálculos pesados en Web Workers; render 3D separado del loop de física cuando sea posible.
* Lazy‑load de módulos por lección; liberar memoria al cambiar de módulo.
* Pruebas en dispositivos de gama baja para asegurar experiencia mínima aceptable.
¿Qué métricas educativas se recomiendan capturar?
* Tiempo de visualización por video, intentos por ejercicio, parámetros más probados, tasa de éxito.
* Exportar reportes para instructores con timestamps vinculados a eventos del video.

agrega este prompt a public/webPages/web-pages.json:
Escena 3D cinematográfica con cortometraje integrado y control por timeline
Entregables
* index.html, styles.css, cinema.js, assets/ con cortometraje en capítulos, pistas de audio stem, modelos y LUTs.
Stack sugerido
* Three.js, video HTML5, postprocessing (bloom, color grading), GSAP para timeline.
Descripción (FAQ)
¿Qué tipo de narrativa se busca?
Crear una experiencia donde un cortometraje se integra en una escena 3D: paneles flotantes reproducen capítulos y la iluminación, cámara y partículas de la escena reaccionan en tiempo real a la pista de audio y a los marcadores del video, generando una narrativa audiovisual inmersiva.
¿Cómo se organiza el timeline?
* El cortometraje se divide en capítulos (cap1, cap2…). Cada capítulo tiene metadatos JSON con start, end, cameraCue, lightingCue, particleCue.
* Un timeline interactivo permite scrubbing; al mover el scrubber la cámara y los efectos se interpolan suavemente entre cues.
¿Qué sucede al scrubbear o saltar capítulos?
* GSAP interpola la cámara y parámetros de postprocessing (exposición, bloom) hacia los valores del capítulo destino.
* Se reproducen transiciones de audio crossfade entre stems si el capítulo cambia.
* Subtítulos y notas aparecen sincronizados.
¿Cómo se integran videos y texturas?
* Videos como texturas en planos 3D para proyecciones; también se usan overlays HTML para subtítulos y accesibilidad.
* Para rendimiento, se usan versiones proxy de baja resolución durante scrubbing y se cargan versiones de alta calidad al detenerse.
¿Qué microinteracciones y controles se ofrecen?
* Play/Pause, Capítulos, Modo Cinemático (camera dolly automático), Modo Explorador (control libre).
* Marcadores de capítulo con previews en miniatura; compartir enlace con timestamp.
¿Qué consideraciones de accesibilidad y fallback?
* Transcripción completa y versión lineal del cortometraje con capítulos navegables.
* prefers-reduced-motion desactiva movimientos de cámara no esenciales y ofrece cortes directos entre capítulos.
¿Cómo se gestiona la calidad visual y rendimiento?
* LUTs para color grading aplicados en postprocessing; HDRI para iluminación realista.
* LOD y culling agresivo; pausar render cuando canvas fuera de viewport.
* Preload de stems de audio y uso de AudioContext para sincronización precisa.
¿Qué pruebas y métricas se recomiendan?
* Medir latencia de scrubbing, tiempos de carga por capítulo, tasa de abandono por capítulo.
* Pruebas en desktop y móviles, con perfiles de red variados.
*

// ── WINDOW TEXTURE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function winTex(rows, cols) {
  const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
  cv.width = 256;
  cv.height = Math.round(256 * (rows / cols) * 1.6);
  const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle = '#09142a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
  const cw = cv.width / cols, ch = cv.height / rows;
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
      if (Math.random() > 0.28) {
        const warm = Math.random() > 0.5;
        ctx.fillStyle = warm
          ? `rgba(255,215,130,${.25 + Math.random() * .45})`
          : `rgba(130,190,255,${.25 + Math.random() * .5})`;
        ctx.fillRect(c * cw + 2, r * ch + 2, cw - 4, ch - 4);
      }
    }
  }
  return new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv);
}

// ── MATERIALS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const mWall = c => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: c, roughness: 0.45, metalness: 0.55 });
const mGlass = (c, tex) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: c, roughness: 0.1, metalness: 0.85, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, map: tex || null });
const mGround = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x07101e, roughness: 0.92, metalness: 0.05 });

function addMesh(geo, mat, px, py, pz) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
  m.position.set(px, py, pz);
  m.castShadow = true;
  m.receiveShadow = true;
  scene.add(m);
  return m;
}

for (const [bx, by, bw] of [[-4.2, 4.8, 5.8], [4.0, 5.5, 4.6], [4.0, 4.0, 4.6]])

// Ground
const ground = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(120, 120), mGround);
ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
ground.receiveShadow = true;

grid.position.y = 0.01;
scene.add(grid);

// Subtle ground glow ring
const glowGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(1, 14, 64);
const glowMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x1a3a80, transparent: true, opacity: 0.12, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
const glow = new THREE.Mesh(glowGeo, glowMat);
glow.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
glow.position.y = 0.02;
scene.add(glow);

// ── HOTSPOT DATA ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const HS = [
  {
    id: 'strategy',
    label: 'Strategy & Vision',

    pos: new THREE.Vector3(-4.2, 4.2, 2.2),
    cam: new THREE.Vector3(-8.5, 6.5, 10),

// ── HOTSPOT MESHES ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const clickables = [];

  );

// ── HTML LABELS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  el.style.setProperty('--hl-bdr', h.hex);
  lc.appendChild(el);
  h._lel = el;
  // ::after border-top-color via inline style on pseudo-element not possible;

});

// ── OVERVIEW CAMERA ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const OVP = new THREE.Vector3(14, 9, 20);
const OVT = new THREE.Vector3(0, 3.5, 0);
let animating = false;

function flyTo(tp, tt, dur, cb) {
  dur = dur || 1.5;
  if (RM) {
    camera.position.copy(tp);
    controls.target.copy(tt);
    controls.update();
    cb && cb();
    return;
  }
  animating = true;
  controls.enabled = false;
  const sp = camera.position.clone(), st = controls.target.clone();
  const proxy = { t: 0 };
  g.to(proxy, {
    t: 1, duration: dur, ease: 'power2.inOut',
    onUpdate() {
      camera.position.lerpVectors(sp, tp, proxy.t);
      controls.target.lerpVectors(st, tt, proxy.t);
      controls.update();
    },
    onComplete() {
      animating = false;
      controls.enabled = true;
      cb && cb();
    }
  });
}

// ── PANEL ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const panel = document.getElementById('panel');
let panelOpen = false;

function countUp(el, target, suf) {
  const isF = target % 1 !== 0;
  const t0 = Date.now(), dur = 900;
  const tick = () => {
    const p = Math.min((Date.now() - t0) / dur, 1);
    const e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
    el.textContent = (isF ? (e * target).toFixed(1) : Math.floor(e * target)) + suf;
    if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  tick();
}

function openPanel(h) {
  const pbadge = document.getElementById('pbadge');
  pbadge.textContent = '● ' + h.label;
  pbadge.style.cssText = `background:${h.hex}18;border:1px solid ${h.hex}44;color:${h.hex}`;
  document.getElementById('ptitle').textContent = h.label;
  document.getElementById('pdesc').textContent = h.desc;
  const kg = document.getElementById('kgrid');
  kg.innerHTML = '';
  h.kpis.forEach(k => {
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'kpi';
    const v = document.createElement('div');
    v.className = 'kv';
    v.style.color = h.hex;
    v.textContent = '0' + k.s;
    const l = document.createElement('div');
    l.className = 'kl';
    l.textContent = k.l;
    d.append(v, l);
    kg.appendChild(d);
    setTimeout(() => countUp(v, k.v, k.s), 250);
  });
  panel.classList.add('open');
  panelOpen = true;
}

function closePanel() {
  panel.classList.remove('open');
  panelOpen = false;
}

document.getElementById('pcls').addEventListener('click', () => {
  closePanel();
  if (!tourActive) flyTo(OVP, OVT, 1.2, null);
});

// ── TOUR ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let tourActive = false, tourIdx = 0, tourTmr = null;
const DWELL = 7500;
const tourEl = document.getElementById('tour');
const tlbl = document.getElementById('tlbl');
const dotsEl = document.getElementById('dots');
const tbtn = document.getElementById('tbtn');

HS.forEach((_, i) => {
  const d = document.createElement('div');
  d.className = 'dot';
  d.id = 'dot-' + i;
  dotsEl.appendChild(d);
});

function updateDots(ai) {
  HS.forEach((_, i) => {
    document.getElementById('dot-' + i).className =
      'dot' + (i === ai ? ' active' : i < ai ? ' done' : '');
  });
}

function startTour() {
  tourActive = true;
  tourIdx = 0;
  tourEl.classList.add('open');
  tbtn.textContent = '■ Stop Tour';
  tbtn.classList.add('active');
  closePanel();
  runTourStep(0);
}

function runTourStep(i) {
  if (!tourActive) return;
  const h = HS[i];
  tlbl.textContent = (i + 1) + ' / ' + HS.length + ' — ' + h.label;
  updateDots(i);
  closePanel();
  flyTo(h.cam, h.tgt, RM ? 0 : 2, function() {
    if (!tourActive) return;
    openPanel(h);
    tourTmr = setTimeout(function() {
      const next = i + 1;
      if (next < HS.length) runTourStep(next);
      else endTour();
    }, DWELL);
  });
}

function endTour() {
  tourActive = false;
  clearTimeout(tourTmr);
  tourEl.classList.remove('open');
  tbtn.textContent = '▶ Start Tour';
  tbtn.classList.remove('active');
  closePanel();
  flyTo(OVP, OVT, 1.5, null);
}

tbtn.addEventListener('click', function() { tourActive ? endTour() : startTour(); });
document.getElementById('tstp').addEventListener('click', endTour);

// ── RAYCASTING ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const ray = new THREE.Raycaster();
const ptr = new THREE.Vector2();

canvas.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (animating || tourActive) return;
  ptr.set((e.clientX / innerWidth) * 2 - 1, -(e.clientY / innerHeight) * 2 + 1);
  ray.setFromCamera(ptr, camera);
  const hits = ray.intersectObjects(clickables);
  if (hits.length) {
    const h = HS.find(x => x.id === hits[0].object.userData.hid);
    if (h) { closePanel(); flyTo(h.cam, h.tgt, 1.5, function() { openPanel(h); }); }
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
  ptr.set((e.clientX / innerWidth) * 2 - 1, -(e.clientY / innerHeight) * 2 + 1);
  ray.setFromCamera(ptr, camera);
  canvas.style.cursor = ray.intersectObjects(clickables).length ? 'pointer' : 'grab';
});

// ── KEYBOARD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') { endTour(); closePanel(); flyTo(OVP, OVT, 1.2, null); }
  const idx = { '1': 0, '2': 1, '3': 2 }[e.key];
  if (idx !== undefined && !tourActive) {
    const h = HS[idx];
    closePanel();
    flyTo(h.cam, h.tgt, 1.5, function() { openPanel(h); });
  }
});

// ── RESIZE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
  camera.aspect = innerWidth / innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  R.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
});

// ── RENDER LOOP ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const clock = new THREE.Clock();
const _v = new THREE.Vector3();

function screenPos(wp) {
  _v.copy(wp).project(camera);
  return {
    x: (_v.x * .5 + .5) * innerWidth,
    y: (-_v.y * .5 + .5) * innerHeight,
    behind: _v.z > 1
  };
}

(function loop() {
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  const t = clock.getElapsedTime();
  controls.update();

  // Animate hotspots & labels
  HS.forEach(function(h, i) {
    if (!RM) {
      const ph = t * 1.5 + i * 1.3;
      h._r1.scale.setScalar(1 + .14 * Math.sin(ph));
      h._r2.scale.setScalar(1 + .22 * Math.sin(ph * .7));
      h._r2.material.opacity = .18 + .14 * Math.sin(ph * .9);
      h._sphere.scale.setScalar(1 + .04 * Math.sin(ph * 2));
    }
    const sp = screenPos(h.pos);
    h._lel.style.left = sp.x + 'px';
    h._lel.style.top = (sp.y - 22) + 'px';
    h._lel.style.opacity = sp.behind ? '0' : '1';
  });

  // Subtle glow pulse
  if (!RM) {
    glowMat.opacity = 0.08 + 0.04 * Math.sin(t * 0.5);
  }

  R.render(scene, camera);
})();
</script>

      { p: 0.82, l: 'Production',   s: 'Deploy & monitor in one click',    t: '1:13' }
    ]
  }
];

// ── PRODUCT MODELS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function buildAnalytics(p) {
  const grp = new THREE.Group();
  const screenMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x09142a, roughness: 0.2, metalness: 0.5 });
  const screen = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.6, 1.0, 0.06), screenMat);
  screen.position.y = 0.62;
  grp.add(screen);
  const edgeGeo = new THREE.EdgesGeometry(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.62, 1.02, 0.08));
  const edgeLine = new THREE.LineSegments(edgeGeo, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: p.col, transparent: true, opacity: 0.5 }));
  edgeLine.position.y = 0.62;
  grp.add(edgeLine);
  const barCols = [p.col, 0x34d399, 0xf59e0b, 0xe74c3c, 0xa78bfa];
  const baseHArr = [0.25, 0.45, 0.35, 0.55, 0.4];
  const bars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const bh = baseHArr[i];
    const barMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: barCols[i], emissive: barCols[i], emissiveIntensity: 0.4 });
    const bar = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.18, bh, 0.02), barMat);
    const barBase = 0.17;
    bar.position.set(-0.42 + i * 0.21, barBase + bh / 2, 0.04);
    grp.add(bar);
    bars.push({ mesh: bar, baseH: bh, bottom: barBase });
  }
  const stand = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.06, 0.14, 0.5, 8),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1a2a4a, metalness: 0.7 })
  );
  stand.position.y = -0.22;
  grp.add(stand);
  p._bars = bars;
  p._edgeLine = edgeLine;
  return grp;
}

function buildCloud(p) {
  const grp = new THREE.Group();
  const hubY = 0.7;
  const hub = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.22, 20, 20),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: p.col, emissive: p.col, emissiveIntensity: 0.25, roughness: 0.2 })
  );
  hub.position.y = hubY;
  grp.add(hub);
  const nodeData = [0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI, (3 * Math.PI) / 2].map(angle => {
    const r = 0.62;
    const node = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.1, 12, 12),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: p.col, emissive: p.col, emissiveIntensity: 0.12 })
    );
    node.position.set(Math.cos(angle) * r, hubY, Math.sin(angle) * r);
    grp.add(node);
    return { mesh: node, angle, r };
  });
  const outerRing = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.75, 0.014, 8, 40),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: p.col, transparent: true, opacity: 0.3 })
  );
  outerRing.position.y = hubY;
  grp.add(outerRing);
  p._hub = hub;
  p._nodes = nodeData;
  p._outerRing = outerRing;
  return grp;
}

function buildAI(p) {
  const grp = new THREE.Group();
  const octY = 0.7;
  const oct = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.38, 0),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: p.col, emissive: p.col, emissiveIntensity: 0.25, roughness: 0.1, metalness: 0.5 })
  );
  oct.position.y = octY;
  grp.add(oct);
  const wireGeo = new THREE.WireframeGeometry(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.4, 0));
  const wire = new THREE.LineSegments(wireGeo, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: p.col, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55 }));
  wire.position.y = octY;
  grp.add(wire);
  const r1 = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.55, 0.012, 8, 32),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: p.col, transparent: true, opacity: 0.4 })
  );
  r1.position.y = octY;
  r1.rotation.x = Math.PI / 4;
  grp.add(r1);
  const r2 = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.7, 0.012, 8, 32),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: p.col, transparent: true, opacity: 0.22 })
  );
  r2.position.y = octY;
  r2.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 3;
  r2.rotation.z = Math.PI / 5;
  grp.add(r2);
  p._oct = oct;
  p._wire = wire;
  p._r1 = r1;
  p._r2 = r2;
  return grp;
}

// ── SHOWCASE BUILDER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const clickables = [];

PRODUCTS.forEach(p => {
  const grp = new THREE.Group();
  grp.position.set(p.px, 0, 0);

  // Pedestal
  const ped = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.1, 1.3, 0.4, 6),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x0e1a30, roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.7 })
  );
  ped.position.y = 0.2;
  ped.castShadow = true;
  grp.add(ped);

  // Accent ring on top of pedestal
  const accentRing = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.TorusGeometry(1.12, 0.03, 8, 30),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: p.col, transparent: true, opacity: 0.45 })
  );
  accentRing.position.y = 0.42;
  accentRing.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
  grp.add(accentRing);

  // Glass showcase walls
  const wallH = 2.1, wallW = 2.0, wallT = 0.04;
  const wallConfigs = [
    { pos: [0, wallH / 2 + 0.42, wallW / 2],  size: [wallW, wallH, wallT] },  // front
    { pos: [0, wallH / 2 + 0.42, -wallW / 2], size: [wallW, wallH, wallT] },  // back
    { pos: [-wallW / 2, wallH / 2 + 0.42, 0], size: [wallT, wallH, wallW] },  // left
    { pos: [wallW / 2, wallH / 2 + 0.42, 0],  size: [wallT, wallH, wallW] },  // right
    { pos: [0, wallH + 0.44, 0], size: [wallW, wallT, wallW] }                 // ceiling
  ];
  const wallOpenDirs = [
    [0, 0, 0.9], [0, 0, -0.9], [-0.9, 0, 0], [0.9, 0, 0], [0, 1.1, 0]
  ];
  const walls = [];
  wallConfigs.forEach(({ pos, size }, wi) => {
    const wm = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(...size),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8abcf5, transparent: true, opacity: 0.12, roughness: 0, metalness: 0.1 })
    );
    wm.position.set(...pos);
    wm._basePos = wm.position.clone();
    wm._openDir = wallOpenDirs[wi];
    // Edge lines as children so they move with the wall
    const edgeGeo = new THREE.EdgesGeometry(new THREE.BoxGeometry(...size));
    const edgeLine = new THREE.LineSegments(
      edgeGeo,
      new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: p.col, transparent: true, opacity: 0.22 })
    );
    wm.add(edgeLine);
    wm._edge = edgeLine;
    grp.add(wm);
    walls.push(wm);
  });
  p._walls = walls;

  // Product model
  let model;
  if (p.id === 'analytics') model = buildAnalytics(p);
  else if (p.id === 'cloud') model = buildCloud(p);
  else model = buildAI(p);
  model.position.y = 0.42;
  grp.add(model);
  p._model = model;

  // Interior point light
  const pt = new THREE.PointLight(p.col, 2.5, 5.5);
  pt.position.set(0, 1.8, 0);
  grp.add(pt);
  p._pt = pt;

  // Invisible click hitbox
  const hb = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.3, 3.1, 2.3),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ visible: false })
  );
  hb.position.y = 1.5;
  hb.userData.pid = p.id;
  clickables.push(hb);
  grp.add(hb);

  scene.add(grp);
  p._grp = grp;
  p._open = false;
});

// ── CAMERA / FLY-TO ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const OVP = new THREE.Vector3(0, 5, 13);
const OVT = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.5, 0);
let animating = false;
let activeProduct = null;

function flyTo(tp, tt, dur, cb) {
  if (RM) { camera.position.copy(tp); controls.target.copy(tt); controls.update(); cb && cb(); return; }
  animating = true;
  controls.enabled = false;
  const sp = camera.position.clone(), st = controls.target.clone();
  const proxy = { t: 0 };
  g.to(proxy, {
    t: 1, duration: dur || 1.3, ease: 'power2.inOut',
    onUpdate() { camera.position.lerpVectors(sp, tp, proxy.t); controls.target.lerpVectors(st, tt, proxy.t); controls.update(); },
    onComplete() { animating = false; controls.enabled = true; cb && cb(); }
  });
}

// ── CASE OPEN / CLOSE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function openCase(p) {
  if (p._open) return;
  p._open = true;
  p._walls.forEach(w => {
    if (!RM) {
      g.to(w.position, { x: w._basePos.x + w._openDir[0], y: w._basePos.y + w._openDir[1], z: w._basePos.z + w._openDir[2], duration: 0.55, ease: 'power2.out' });
      g.to(w.material, { opacity: 0.03, duration: 0.35 });
      g.to(w._edge.material, { opacity: 0.55, duration: 0.4 });
    } else { w.material.opacity = 0.03; }
  });
  if (!RM) {
    g.to(p._pt, { intensity: 5.5, duration: 0.4 });
    g.to(p._model.scale, { x: 1.1, y: 1.1, z: 1.1, duration: 0.5, ease: 'back.out(1.4)' });
  }
}

function closeCase(p) {
  if (!p._open) return;
  p._open = false;
  p._walls.forEach(w => {
    if (!RM) {
      g.to(w.position, { x: w._basePos.x, y: w._basePos.y, z: w._basePos.z, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power2.inOut' });
      g.to(w.material, { opacity: 0.12, duration: 0.35 });
      g.to(w._edge.material, { opacity: 0.22, duration: 0.35 });
    } else { w.material.opacity = 0.12; }
  });
  if (!RM) {
    g.to(p._pt, { intensity: 2.5, duration: 0.3 });
    g.to(p._model.scale, { x: 1, y: 1, z: 1, duration: 0.4 });
  } else { p._model.scale.set(1, 1, 1); }
}

// ── VIDEO PLAYER STATE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let vidProg = 0;
let vidPlaying = false;
let vidStartTs = null;
let vidRaf = null;

function fmtTime(secs) {
  const m = Math.floor(secs / 60), s = Math.floor(secs % 60);
  return m + ':' + String(s).padStart(2, '0');
}

function updateVideoUI(prog, p) {
  vidProg = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, prog));
  const pct = vidProg * 100;
  document.getElementById('prog-fill').style.width = pct + '%';
  document.getElementById('prog-handle').style.left = pct + '%';
  document.getElementById('player-bar').style.width = pct + '%';
  document.getElementById('prog-wrap').setAttribute('aria-valuenow', Math.round(pct));
  document.getElementById('ctrl-time').textContent = fmtTime(vidProg * p.dur) + ' / ' + p.durFmt;

  // Chapter highlight
  let ci = 0;
  p.chapters.forEach((ch, i) => { if (vidProg >= ch.p) ci = i; });
  p.chapters.forEach((_, i) => {
    const el = document.getElementById('chi-' + i);
    if (el) el.className = 'ch-item' + (i === ci ? ' active' : '');
  });
  const ch = p.chapters[ci];
  document.getElementById('ctrl-lbl').textContent = ch ? ch.l : '';
  const ov = document.getElementById('ch-ov');
  ov.textContent = ch ? ch.l : '';
  ov.className = 'ch-ov show';

  // Background gradient per progress
  const hue = 200 + vidProg * 70;
  document.getElementById('player-bg').style.background =
    `linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(${hue},40%,7%), hsl(${hue + 25},55%,14%))`;
}

function tickVideo(now) {
  if (!vidPlaying || !activeProduct) return;
  if (!vidStartTs) vidStartTs = now - vidProg * activeProduct.dur * 1000;
  const elapsed = (now - vidStartTs) / 1000;
  const prog = elapsed / activeProduct.dur;
  if (prog >= 1) {
    updateVideoUI(1, activeProduct);
    vidPlaying = false;
    document.getElementById('play-btn').innerHTML = '&#9654;';
    return;
  }
  updateVideoUI(prog, activeProduct);
  vidRaf = requestAnimationFrame(tickVideo);
}

document.getElementById('play-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (!activeProduct) return;
  vidPlaying = !vidPlaying;
  document.getElementById('play-btn').innerHTML = vidPlaying ? '&#9646;&#9646;' : '&#9654;';
  if (vidPlaying) {
    vidStartTs = performance.now() - vidProg * activeProduct.dur * 1000;
    vidRaf = requestAnimationFrame(tickVideo);
  } else {
    cancelAnimationFrame(vidRaf);
  }
});

// Progress bar scrubbing
const progWrap = document.getElementById('prog-wrap');
let scrubbing = false;

function scrubAt(cx) {
  if (!activeProduct) return;
  const rect = progWrap.getBoundingClientRect();
  const p = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (cx - rect.left) / rect.width));
  vidStartTs = null;
  updateVideoUI(p, activeProduct);
}
progWrap.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { scrubbing = true; scrubAt(e.clientX); });
window.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { if (scrubbing) scrubAt(e.clientX); });
window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { scrubbing = false; });
progWrap.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { scrubbing = true; scrubAt(e.touches[0].clientX); }, { passive: true });
window.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { if (scrubbing) scrubAt(e.touches[0].clientX); }, { passive: true });
window.addEventListener('touchend', () => { scrubbing = false; });

// ── SELECT PRODUCT ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function selectProduct(p) {
  if (activeProduct && activeProduct !== p) { closeCase(activeProduct); }
  activeProduct = p;
  openCase(p);
  flyTo(new THREE.Vector3(p.px, 4.5, 9), new THREE.Vector3(p.px, 1.5, 0), 1.3, null);

  // Populate panel
  document.getElementById('ph-badge').textContent = p.category;
  document.getElementById('ph-badge').style.cssText = `background:${p.hex}18;border:1px solid ${p.hex}44;color:${p.hex}`;
  document.getElementById('ph-title-el').textContent = p.name;
  document.getElementById('ph-tagline').textContent = p.tagline;
  document.getElementById('ph-desc').textContent = p.desc;
  document.getElementById('ctrl-time').textContent = '0:00 / ' + p.durFmt;
  document.getElementById('cta-p').style.background = p.hex;
  document.getElementById('prog-fill').style.background = p.hex;

  // Chapter pips + list
  const track = document.getElementById('prog-track');
  track.querySelectorAll('.ch-pip').forEach(el => el.remove());
  const cs = document.getElementById('chapters-section');
  cs.innerHTML = '<div class="sec-lbl">Chapters</div>';
  p.chapters.forEach((ch, i) => {
    if (i > 0) {
      const pip = document.createElement('div');
      pip.className = 'ch-pip';
      pip.style.left = ch.p * 100 + '%';
      track.appendChild(pip);
    }
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'ch-item' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
    el.id = 'chi-' + i;
    el.innerHTML = `<div class="ch-dot" style="background:${p.hex}"></div><div class="ch-info"><div class="ch-label">${ch.l}</div><div class="ch-sub">${ch.s}</div></div><div class="ch-ts">${ch.t}</div>`;
    el.addEventListener('click', () => { vidStartTs = null; updateVideoUI(ch.p, p); });
    cs.appendChild(el);
  });

  // Specs
  const ss = document.getElementById('specs-section');
  ss.innerHTML = `<div class="sec-lbl">Capabilities</div><div class="chips">${p.specs.map(s => `<div class="chip">${s}</div>`).join('')}</div><div class="sec-lbl" style="margin-top:8px">Integrations</div><div class="chips">${p.integrations.map(s => `<div class="int-chip">${s}</div>`).join('')}</div>`;

  // Reset video
  vidProg = 0; vidPlaying = false; vidStartTs = null;
  cancelAnimationFrame(vidRaf);
  document.getElementById('play-btn').innerHTML = '&#9654;';
  updateVideoUI(0, p);

  document.getElementById('panel').classList.add('open');
}

function deselect() {
  if (activeProduct) { closeCase(activeProduct); activeProduct = null; }
  vidPlaying = false;
  cancelAnimationFrame(vidRaf);
  document.getElementById('panel').classList.remove('open');
  flyTo(OVP, OVT, 1.2, null);
}

document.getElementById('ph-close').addEventListener('click', deselect);

// ── 2D FALLBACK ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const fbGrid = document.getElementById('fb-grid');
PRODUCTS.forEach(p => {
  const card = document.createElement('div');
  card.className = 'fb-card';
  card.innerHTML = `
    <div class="fb-thumb" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,${p.hex}22,${p.hex}08)">${p.icon}</div>
    <div class="fb-body">
      <div class="fb-name">${p.name}</div>
      <div class="fb-cat" style="color:${p.hex}">${p.category}</div>
      <div class="fb-desc">${p.desc}</div>
      <div class="chips">${p.specs.slice(0, 4).map(s => `<div class="chip">${s}</div>`).join('')}</div>
    </div>`;
  fbGrid.appendChild(card);
});
const fallback = document.getElementById('fallback');
document.getElementById('btn2d').addEventListener('click', () => fallback.classList.add('show'));
document.getElementById('fb-close').addEventListener('click', () => fallback.classList.remove('show'));

// ── HOVER & CLICK ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const tooltip = document.getElementById('tooltip');
const ray = new THREE.Raycaster();
const ptr = new THREE.Vector2();
let hovered = null;

function hitProduct(e) {
  ptr.set((e.clientX / innerWidth) * 2 - 1, -(e.clientY / innerHeight) * 2 + 1);
  ray.setFromCamera(ptr, camera);
  const hits = ray.intersectObjects(clickables);
  return hits.length ? PRODUCTS.find(p => p.id === hits[0].object.userData.pid) : null;
}

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  const hit = hitProduct(e);
  canvas.style.cursor = hit ? 'pointer' : 'grab';
  if (hit) {
    hovered = hit;
    document.getElementById('tt-name').textContent = hit.name;
    document.getElementById('tt-tag').textContent = hit.category;
    tooltip.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
    tooltip.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
    tooltip.classList.add('show');
  } else {
    hovered = null;
    tooltip.classList.remove('show');
  }
});
canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { tooltip.classList.remove('show'); hovered = null; });
canvas.addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (animating) return;
  const hit = hitProduct(e);
  if (hit) selectProduct(hit);
});

// ── KEYBOARD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') deselect();
  const idx = { '1': 0, '2': 1, '3': 2 }[e.key];
  if (idx !== undefined) selectProduct(PRODUCTS[idx]);
});

// ── RESIZE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
  camera.aspect = innerWidth / innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  R.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
});

// ── RENDER LOOP ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const clock = new THREE.Clock();

(function loop() {
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  const t = clock.getElapsedTime();
  controls.update();

  PRODUCTS.forEach((p, i) => {
    const isActive = activeProduct === p;
    const prog = isActive ? vidProg : 0;
    const base = t + i * 1.5;

    // Analytics: animated bars
    if (p.id === 'analytics' && p._bars) {
      p._bars.forEach((b, j) => {
        const wave = RM ? 0 : 0.12 * Math.sin(t * 1.1 + j * 0.9);
        const scale = isActive ? (0.55 + prog * 0.7 + wave) : (0.8 + wave * 0.5);
        b.mesh.scale.y = scale;
        b.mesh.position.y = b.bottom + (b.baseH * scale) / 2;
        b.mesh.material.emissiveIntensity = isActive ? 0.3 + prog * 0.8 : 0.25;
      });
      if (p._edgeLine) p._edgeLine.material.opacity = isActive ? 0.5 + 0.3 * Math.sin(t * 2) : 0.3;
    }

    // Cloud: orbiting nodes
    if (p.id === 'cloud' && p._nodes) {
      const speed = isActive ? 0.3 + prog * 1.8 : 0.3;
      const radius = isActive ? 0.52 + prog * 0.22 : 0.62;
      p._nodes.forEach(n => {
        if (!RM) n.angle += 0.008 * speed;
        n.mesh.position.x = Math.cos(n.angle) * radius;
        n.mesh.position.z = Math.sin(n.angle) * radius;
      });
      if (p._hub) {
        p._hub.material.emissiveIntensity = isActive ? 0.2 + prog * 0.9 : 0.2;
        if (!RM) p._hub.rotation.y = t * 0.5;
      }
      if (p._outerRing && !RM) p._outerRing.rotation.z = t * 0.25;
    }

    // AI: rotating octahedron
    if (p.id === 'ai' && p._oct) {
      if (!RM) {
        const rs = isActive ? 0.4 + prog * 1.4 : 0.35;
        p._oct.rotation.y = t * rs;
        p._oct.rotation.x = t * 0.18;
        p._wire.rotation.y = -t * 0.5;
        p._r1.rotation.z = t * 0.6;
        p._r2.rotation.z = -t * 0.4;
        p._r2.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 0.3) * 0.4 - Math.PI / 3;
      }
      p._oct.material.emissiveIntensity = isActive ? 0.2 + prog * 0.9 : 0.2;
      if (p._wire) p._wire.material.opacity = isActive ? 0.35 + prog * 0.45 : 0.4;
    }

    // Hover glow on point light
    if (p._pt && !RM) {
      const targetI = isActive ? 5.5 : (hovered === p ? 4.5 : 2.5);
      p._pt.intensity += (targetI - p._pt.intensity) * 0.1;
    }
  });

  R.render(scene, camera);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
<title>3D Compliance & Audit Center</title>
<script type="importmap">{"imports":{"three":"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.158.0/build/three.module.js","three/addons/":"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.158.0/examples/jsm/"}}</script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/gsap.min.js"></script>
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --bg:#03050a;--panel:#0a0e1a;--border:#1a2235;--text:#e2e8f0;--muted:#64748b;
  --crit:#ef4444;--high:#f97316;--med:#f59e0b;--low:#3b82f6;--info:#22c55e;
  --accent:#6366f1;--font:system-ui,sans-serif
}
body{font-family:var(--font);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);overflow:hidden;height:100vh}
canvas{display:block}

/* NAV */
#nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:52px;background:rgba(3,5,10,0.92);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 1.25rem;gap:1rem;z-index:50;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
#nav .logo{font-weight:800;font-size:0.95rem;letter-spacing:-0.3px;margin-right:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.logo-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--accent)}
.filter-btn{padding:5px 14px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;letter-spacing:.04em}
.filter-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--text)}
.filter-btn.active{color:#fff;border-color:transparent}
.filter-btn[data-sev="ALL"].active{background:var(--accent)}
.filter-btn[data-sev="CRITICAL"].active{background:var(--crit);border-color:var(--crit)}
.filter-btn[data-sev="HIGH"].active{background:var(--high);border-color:var(--high)}
.filter-btn[data-sev="MEDIUM"].active{background:var(--med);border-color:var(--med)}
.filter-btn[data-sev="LOW"].active{background:var(--low);border-color:var(--low)}
.filter-btn[data-sev="INFO"].active{background:var(--info);border-color:var(--info)}
.nav-sep{width:1px;height:20px;background:var(--border)}
#toggle2d{padding:5px 14px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
#toggle2d:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--text)}

/* SIDE PANEL */
#panel{position:fixed;top:52px;right:0;bottom:0;width:380px;background:var(--panel);border-left:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;flex-direction:column;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateX(30px);transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s;z-index:40;overflow:hidden}
#panel.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:all;transform:translateX(0)}
#panel-close{position:absolute;top:12px;right:14px;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:1.1rem;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px}
#panel-close:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--border)}
#panel-sev{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:4px;font-size:0.65rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px}
#panel-title{font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px}
#panel-node{font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:1rem}

/* VIDEO PLAYER */
.video-wrap{background:#000;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:1rem;position:relative}
.video-screen{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0a0e1a,#0d1526);font-size:2rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.vid-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:flex-end;padding:14px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.7))}
.vid-label{font-size:0.68rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);margin-bottom:4px}
.vid-ep{font-size:0.82rem;font-weight:600;color:#fff}
.vid-controls{padding:10px 12px;background:#0a0e1a}
.progress-track{width:100%;height:4px;background:#1e293b;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px;position:relative}
.progress-fill{height:100%;border-radius:2px;background:var(--accent);pointer-events:none}
.vid-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.vid-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;font-size:.85rem;padding:3px}
.vid-btn:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.vid-time{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--muted);margin-left:auto}
.chapter-markers{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px}
.chap{padding:3px 9px;border-radius:3px;font-size:0.65rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted);background:transparent;transition:all .15s}
.chap:hover,.chap.active{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}

/* AUDIT TIMELINE */
.panel-section{padding:0 1rem}
.section-label{font-size:0.65rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:.6rem}
#audit-timeline{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;max-height:160px;overflow-y:auto}
.aud-step{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid var(--border)}
.aud-icon{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.7rem;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px}
.aud-body{flex:1;min-width:0}
.aud-action{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text)}
.aud-time{font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted)}

/* LOG ENTRIES */
#log-entries{max-height:130px;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.log-line{font-size:.68rem;font-family:monospace;color:var(--muted);padding:4px 8px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);border-left:2px solid var(--border);line-height:1.5}
.log-line.crit{border-color:var(--crit);color:#fca5a5}
.log-line.high{border-color:var(--high);color:#fdba74}
.log-line.med{border-color:var(--med);color:#fcd34d}

/* CHART */
#chart-wrap{margin:0 1rem;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.chart-bar-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:5px}
.chart-label{font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted);width:55px;text-align:right;flex-shrink:0}
.chart-bar-track{flex:1;height:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}
.chart-bar-fill{height:100%;border-radius:4px;transition:width .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.chart-count{font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted);width:20px;text-align:left;flex-shrink:0}

/* 2D TABLE */
#view2d{position:fixed;top:52px;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:var(--bg);overflow-y:auto;display:none;z-index:30;padding:1.5rem}
#view2d h2{font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:1rem}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.8rem}
th{text-align:left;padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted);font-size:.65rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:600}
td{padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:var(--text)}
tr:hover td{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.sev-badge{padding:2px 8px;border-radius:3px;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em}

/* NODE LABELS */
.node-label{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);font-size:.62rem;font-weight:600;color:rgba(226,232,240,.75);background:rgba(3,5,10,.7);padding:2px 7px;border-radius:3px;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.04em;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);z-index:20}

/* SCROLLBAR */
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border);border-radius:2px}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  #panel{transition:none}
  .filter-btn,.chap{transition:none}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav id="nav">
  <div class="logo"><div class="logo-dot"></div>AuditCore 3D</div>
  <button class="filter-btn active" data-sev="ALL">All</button>
  <button class="filter-btn" data-sev="CRITICAL">Critical</button>
  <button class="filter-btn" data-sev="HIGH">High</button>
  <button class="filter-btn" data-sev="MEDIUM">Medium</button>
  <button class="filter-btn" data-sev="LOW">Low</button>
  <button class="filter-btn" data-sev="INFO">Info</button>
  <div class="nav-sep"></div>
  <button id="toggle2d">2D Table</button>
</nav>

<!-- 3D CANVAS -->
<canvas id="c"></canvas>

<!-- NODE LABELS -->
<div id="labels"></div>

<!-- SIDE PANEL -->
<div id="panel">
  <button id="panel-close">✕</button>
  <div style="padding:1rem 1rem .5rem">
    <div id="panel-sev"></div>
    <div id="panel-title"></div>
    <div id="panel-node"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- VIDEO -->
  <div style="padding:0 1rem .5rem">
    <div class="video-wrap">
      <div class="video-screen" id="vid-screen">
        <div class="vid-overlay">
          <div class="vid-label">Audit Replay</div>
          <div class="vid-ep" id="vid-ep-title">Incident Recording</div>
        </div>
        <div id="vid-emoji" style="font-size:2.5rem;opacity:.35">🔍</div>
      </div>
      <div class="vid-controls">
        <div class="progress-track" id="prog-track">
          <div class="progress-fill" id="prog-fill" style="width:0%"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="vid-row">
          <button class="vid-btn" id="vid-prev">⏮</button>
          <button class="vid-btn" id="vid-play">▶</button>
          <button class="vid-btn" id="vid-next">⏭</button>
          <span class="vid-time" id="vid-time">0:00 / 0:00</span>
        </div>
        <div class="chapter-markers" id="chap-list"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- CHART -->
  <div style="padding:0 1rem .75rem">
    <div class="section-label">Severity Distribution</div>
    <div id="chart-wrap">
      <div class="chart-bar-row"><div class="chart-label">Critical</div><div class="chart-bar-track"><div class="chart-bar-fill" id="cb-crit" style="background:var(--crit);width:0%"></div></div><div class="chart-count" id="cc-crit">0</div></div>
      <div class="chart-bar-row"><div class="chart-label">High</div><div class="chart-bar-track"><div class="chart-bar-fill" id="cb-high" style="background:var(--high);width:0%"></div></div><div class="chart-count" id="cc-high">0</div></div>
      <div class="chart-bar-row"><div class="chart-label">Medium</div><div class="chart-bar-track"><div class="chart-bar-fill" id="cb-med" style="background:var(--med);width:0%"></div></div><div class="chart-count" id="cc-med">0</div></div>
      <div class="chart-bar-row"><div class="chart-label">Low</div><div class="chart-bar-track"><div class="chart-bar-fill" id="cb-low" style="background:var(--low);width:0%"></div></div><div class="chart-count" id="cc-low">0</div></div>
      <div class="chart-bar-row"><div class="chart-label">Info</div><div class="chart-bar-track"><div class="chart-bar-fill" id="cb-info" style="background:var(--info);width:0%"></div></div><div class="chart-count" id="cc-info">0</div></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- AUDIT TIMELINE -->
  <div class="panel-section" style="margin-bottom:.75rem">
    <div class="section-label">Audit Trail</div>
    <div id="audit-timeline"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- LOGS -->
  <div class="panel-section" style="flex:1;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column">
    <div class="section-label">Log Entries</div>
    <div id="log-entries"></div>
  </div>

  <div style="padding:.75rem 1rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;gap:8px">
    <button style="flex:1;padding:8px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer">Export PDF</button>
    <button style="flex:1;padding:8px;border-radius:6px;border:none;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer">Assign Task</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- 2D TABLE -->
<div id="view2d">
  <h2>Incident Registry</h2>
  <table id="inc-table">
    <thead><tr><th>ID</th><th>Severity</th><th>Description</th><th>Node</th><th>Timestamp</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody id="inc-tbody"></tbody>
  </table>
</div>

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

// ─── DATA ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const NODES = [
  {id:'GW',   label:'Gateway',     pos:[-7.5, 0, 0],    color:0x6366f1, zone:'perimeter'},
  {id:'W1',   label:'Web-01',      pos:[-5.0, 0,-1.8],  color:0x38bdf8, zone:'internal'},
  {id:'W2',   label:'Web-02',      pos:[-5.0, 0, 1.8],  color:0x38bdf8, zone:'internal'},
  {id:'A1',   label:'App-01',      pos:[-1.5, 0,-1.8],  color:0x34d399, zone:'internal'},
  {id:'A2',   label:'App-02',      pos:[-1.5, 0, 1.8],  color:0x34d399, zone:'internal'},
  {id:'AU',   label:'Auth-Svc',    pos:[ 1.0, 0, 0],    color:0xa78bfa, zone:'internal'},
  {id:'DB1',  label:'DB-Primary',  pos:[ 4.5, 0,-1.2],  color:0xf472b6, zone:'data'},
  {id:'DB2',  label:'DB-Replica',  pos:[ 4.5, 0, 1.2],  color:0xf472b6, zone:'data'},
  {id:'CA',   label:'Cache',       pos:[ 6.8, 0, 0],    color:0xfbbf24, zone:'data'},
];
const EDGES = [
  ['GW','W1'],['GW','W2'],
  ['W1','A1'],['W2','A2'],
  ['A1','AU'],['A2','AU'],
  ['AU','DB1'],['AU','DB2'],
  ['DB1','CA'],['DB2','CA'],
];
const INCIDENTS = [
  {
    id:'INC-001', sev:'CRITICAL', node:'DB-Primary', nodeId:'DB1',
    title:'SQL Injection Detected', ts:'2024-01-15 03:22:11', status:'Open',
    desc:'Malicious SQL payload intercepted in authentication query. Potential data exfiltration attempt on primary database.',
    emoji:'🔴', dur:210,
    chapters:[{t:'Intro',s:0},{t:'Attack Vector',s:45},{t:'Impact Scope',s:120},{t:'Remediation',s:175}],
    trail:[
      {icon:'🔍',color:'#ef4444',action:'Anomaly Detected by SIEM',time:'03:22:11'},
      {icon:'🚨',color:'#ef4444',action:'Critical Alert Raised',time:'03:22:14'},
      {icon:'🔒',color:'#f97316',action:'DB Connection Quarantined',time:'03:22:18'},
      {icon:'📞',color:'#6366f1',action:'Security Team Notified',time:'03:22:45'},
      {icon:'🛡',color:'#22c55e',action:'WAF Rule Updated',time:'03:31:00'},
    ],
    logs:[
      {cls:'crit', txt:'[03:22:11] CRITICAL: SQLi detected — payload: \' OR 1=1; DROP TABLE users--'},
      {cls:'crit', txt:'[03:22:12] CRITICAL: 847 rows accessed before block — DB-Primary:5432'},
      {cls:'high', txt:'[03:22:15] HIGH: Outbound connection attempt from DB-Primary to 45.33.xx.xx'},
      {cls:'', txt:'[03:22:18] INFO: Connection from App-01 to DB-Primary suspended'},
      {cls:'', txt:'[03:22:45] INFO: Incident escalated to user@example.com'},
    ],
  },
  {
    id:'INC-002', sev:'HIGH', node:'Gateway', nodeId:'GW',
    title:'Brute Force — Login Endpoint', ts:'2024-01-15 07:44:30', status:'Contained',
    desc:'Distributed brute force attack targeting /api/auth/login. 12,400 failed attempts from 340 distinct IPs over 8 minutes.',
    emoji:'🟠', dur:155,
    chapters:[{t:'Overview',s:0},{t:'Attack Map',s:40},{t:'Blocked IPs',s:95},{t:'Hardening',s:130}],
    trail:[
      {icon:'📊',color:'#f97316',action:'Rate Limit Threshold Exceeded',time:'07:44:30'},
      {icon:'🔍',color:'#f59e0b',action:'IP Reputation Check Triggered',time:'07:44:35'},
      {icon:'🚫',color:'#ef4444',action:'340 IPs Blocklisted',time:'07:45:12'},
      {icon:'✅',color:'#22c55e',action:'Attack Traffic Dropped 98%',time:'07:52:00'},
    ],
    logs:[
      {cls:'high', txt:'[07:44:30] HIGH: 1,450 req/min on /api/auth/login — threshold: 200'},
      {cls:'high', txt:'[07:44:35] HIGH: Distributed source — 340 IPs in 22 countries'},
      {cls:'med', txt:'[07:44:40] MEDIUM: Auth-Svc CPU spike to 94%'},
      {cls:'', txt:'[07:45:12] INFO: GeoBlock rule applied — CN,RU,KP range blocked'},
    ],
  },
  {
    id:'INC-003', sev:'MEDIUM', node:'App-01', nodeId:'A1',
    title:'Unpatched Dependency CVE', ts:'2024-01-15 09:10:05', status:'Mitigating',
    desc:'CVE-2023-44487 (HTTP/2 Rapid Reset) detected in App-01 node.js runtime v18.12.0. Upgrade required to v18.19.0.',
    emoji:'🟡', dur:95,
    chapters:[{t:'CVE Details',s:0},{t:'Exposure',s:30},{t:'Patch Plan',s:65}],
    trail:[
      {icon:'🔎',color:'#f59e0b',action:'Vulnerability Scan Completed',time:'09:10:05'},
      {icon:'📋',color:'#6366f1',action:'CVE-2023-44487 Identified',time:'09:10:06'},
      {icon:'🗓',color:'#3b82f6',action:'Patch Scheduled — Maintenance Window',time:'09:30:00'},
    ],
    logs:[
      {cls:'med', txt:'[09:10:05] MEDIUM: CVE-2023-44487 — CVSS 7.5 — App-01 node:18.12.0'},
      {cls:'', txt:'[09:10:06] INFO: Affected endpoints: /api/stream, /api/events'},
      {cls:'', txt:'[09:30:00] INFO: Maintenance window scheduled 2024-01-16 02:00 UTC'},
    ],
  },
  {
    id:'INC-004', sev:'LOW', node:'Cache', nodeId:'CA',
    title:'Cache Expiry Misconfiguration', ts:'2024-01-15 11:55:00', status:'Resolved',
    desc:'Session tokens cached with TTL of 7 days instead of policy-required 24h. Tokens have been invalidated and policy enforced.',
    emoji:'🔵', dur:75,
    chapters:[{t:'Discovery',s:0},{t:'Policy Gap',s:25},{t:'Resolution',s:55}],
    trail:[
      {icon:'🔍',color:'#3b82f6',action:'Routine Policy Audit',time:'11:55:00'},
      {icon:'⚠',color:'#f59e0b',action:'TTL Discrepancy Found',time:'11:55:10'},
      {icon:'🔄',color:'#22c55e',action:'All Sessions Invalidated',time:'12:01:00'},
      {icon:'✅',color:'#22c55e',action:'Policy Corrected & Deployed',time:'12:05:30'},
    ],
    logs:[
      {cls:'', txt:'[11:55:00] LOW: Cache TTL for session:* set to 604800s (7d) — expected 86400s'},
      {cls:'', txt:'[12:01:00] INFO: 4,832 active sessions invalidated'},
      {cls:'', txt:'[12:05:30] INFO: Redis maxTTL policy enforced via config-map update'},
    ],
  },
  {
    id:'INC-005', sev:'INFO', node:'Auth-Svc', nodeId:'AU',
    title:'Certificate Renewal Alert', ts:'2024-01-15 14:00:00', status:'Scheduled',
    desc:'TLS certificate for auth.internal expires in 14 days. Auto-renewal scheduled via Let\'s Encrypt ACME protocol.',
    emoji:'🟢', dur:60,
    chapters:[{t:'Certificate',s:0},{t:'Schedule',s:30}],
    trail:[
      {icon:'📅',color:'#22c55e',action:'Cert Expiry Check — 14 days',time:'14:00:00'},
      {icon:'🤖',color:'#6366f1',action:'ACME Renewal Queued',time:'14:00:05'},
    ],
    logs:[
      {cls:'', txt:'[14:00:00] INFO: cert:auth.internal expires 2024-01-29 — 14 days remaining'},
      {cls:'', txt:'[14:00:05] INFO: ACME renewal job queued for 2024-01-27 02:00 UTC'},
    ],
  },
];

const SEV_COLORS = {CRITICAL:'#ef4444',HIGH:'#f97316',MEDIUM:'#f59e0b',LOW:'#3b82f6',INFO:'#22c55e'};
const SEV_HEX    = {CRITICAL:0xef4444,HIGH:0xf97316,MEDIUM:0xf59e0b,LOW:0x3b82f6,INFO:0x22c55e};

// ─── RENDERER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas, antialias:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio,2));
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
renderer.toneMappingExposure = 0.85;

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x03050a);
scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x03050a, 0.045);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55, 1, 0.1, 200);
camera.position.set(0, 12, 18);

const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, canvas);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.dampingFactor = 0.06;
controls.target.set(0, 0, 0);
controls.minDistance = 4;
controls.maxDistance = 35;
controls.maxPolarAngle = Math.PI * 0.48;

// ─── LIGHTS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x0a0e1a, 2));
const dir = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x7090ff, 1.2);
dir.position.set(5, 14, 8);
dir.castShadow = true;
dir.shadow.mapSize.set(1024, 1024);
scene.add(dir);
const pt1 = new THREE.PointLight(0x6366f1, 2, 20); pt1.position.set(0,3,0); scene.add(pt1);
const pt2 = new THREE.PointLight(0x38bdf8, 1.5, 15); pt2.position.set(-6,2,0); scene.add(pt2);
const pt3 = new THREE.PointLight(0xf472b6, 1.5, 12); pt3.position.set(5,2,0); scene.add(pt3);

// ─── GRID & FLOOR ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(30, 30, 0x0d1a2d, 0x0d1a2d);
grid.position.y = -0.01;
scene.add(grid);

const floorGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(30,30);
const floorMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x030710,roughness:1,metalness:0});
const floor = new THREE.Mesh(floorGeo, floorMat);
floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2; floor.receiveShadow = true;
scene.add(floor);

// ─── ZONE PLANES ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function makeZone(x, z, w, d, color, alpha) {
  const g = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, d);
  const m = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color, transparent:true, opacity:alpha, side:THREE.DoubleSide});
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(g, m);
  mesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
  mesh.position.set(x, 0.01, z);
  scene.add(mesh);
  // border
  const box = new THREE.Box3(); box.setFromObject(mesh);
  const edges = new THREE.EdgesGeometry(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w,d));
  const eLine = new THREE.LineSegments(edges, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color, transparent:true, opacity:0.3}));
  eLine.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2; eLine.position.copy(mesh.position);
  scene.add(eLine);
}
makeZone(-6.5, 0,  4,  6, 0x6366f1, 0.05); // perimeter
makeZone(-2.0, 0, 10,  6, 0x38bdf8, 0.04); // internal
makeZone( 5.5, 0,  5,  5, 0xf472b6, 0.04); // data

// zone labels
function makeZoneLabel(text, x, z, color) {
  const canvas2 = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas2.width = 256; canvas2.height = 48;
  const ctx = canvas2.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle = color + '22';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,256,48);
  ctx.font = 'bold 18px system-ui';
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText(text, 128, 24);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas2);
  const plane = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.PlaneGeometry(3.5, 0.65),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:tex, transparent:true, depthWrite:false})
  );
  plane.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
  plane.position.set(x, 0.02, z);
  scene.add(plane);
}
makeZoneLabel('PERIMETER ZONE', -6.5, 2.4, '#6366f1');
makeZoneLabel('INTERNAL NETWORK', -2.0, 2.4, '#38bdf8');
makeZoneLabel('DATA LAYER', 5.5, 1.8, '#f472b6');

// ─── NODE MESHES ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const nodeMap = {};
const nodeMeshes = [];

function makeNode(n) {
  const grp = new THREE.Group();
  grp.position.set(...n.pos);
  scene.add(grp);

  // base platform
  const baseGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.55, 0.6, 0.06, 16);
  const baseMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x0d1a2d, metalness:0.5, roughness:0.5});
  const base = new THREE.Mesh(baseGeo, baseMat);
  base.receiveShadow = true;
  grp.add(base);

  // body
  let bodyGeo;
  if (n.id === 'GW') bodyGeo = new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.55);
  else if (n.id.startsWith('DB')) bodyGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.38, 0.42, 0.9, 16);
  else if (n.id === 'CA') bodyGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.75, 0.55, 0.55);
  else bodyGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.6, 0.75, 0.6);
  const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:n.color, metalness:0.6, roughness:0.3, emissive:n.color, emissiveIntensity:0.15});
  const body = new THREE.Mesh(bodyGeo, bodyMat);
  body.castShadow = true;
  body.position.y = 0.55;
  grp.add(body);

  // glow ring
  const ringGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.62, 0.68, 32);
  const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:n.color, transparent:true, opacity:0.4, side:THREE.DoubleSide});
  const ring = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, ringMat);
  ring.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
  ring.position.y = 0.03;
  grp.add(ring);

  // hitbox for raycasting
  const hitGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.2, 1.6, 1.2);
  const hitMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({visible:false});
  const hit = new THREE.Mesh(hitGeo, hitMat);
  hit.position.y = 0.55;
  hit.userData.nodeId = n.id;
  grp.add(hit);
  nodeMeshes.push(hit);

  nodeMap[n.id] = {grp, body, bodyMat, ring, ringMat, data:n};
  return grp;
}

NODES.forEach(makeNode);

// ─── CONNECTIONS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EDGES.forEach(([a,b]) => {
  const na = NODES.find(n=>n.id===a);
  const nb = NODES.find(n=>n.id===b);
  const pts = [new THREE.Vector3(...na.pos), new THREE.Vector3(...nb.pos)];
  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts);
  const mat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:0x1e3a5f, transparent:true, opacity:0.6});
  scene.add(new THREE.Line(geo, mat));
});

// ─── INCIDENT MARKERS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const incMarkers = {};
function makeIncMarker(inc) {
  const nd = NODES.find(n=>n.id===inc.nodeId);
  if (!nd) return;
  const grp = new THREE.Group();
  grp.position.set(nd.pos[0]+0.5, 1.4, nd.pos[2]+0.5);
  scene.add(grp);

  const col = SEV_HEX[inc.sev];

  // diamond
  const dGeo = new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.2);
  const dMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:col, emissive:col, emissiveIntensity:0.8, metalness:0.3, roughness:0.3});
  const diamond = new THREE.Mesh(dGeo, dMat);
  grp.add(diamond);

  // pulse ring
  const prGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.25, 0.3, 24);
  const prMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:col, transparent:true, opacity:0.6, side:THREE.DoubleSide});
  const pr = new THREE.Mesh(prGeo, prMat);
  pr.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
  grp.add(pr);

  // outer pulse
  const pr2Geo = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.35, 0.38, 24);
  const pr2Mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:col, transparent:true, opacity:0.3, side:THREE.DoubleSide});
  const pr2 = new THREE.Mesh(pr2Geo, pr2Mat);
  pr2.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
  grp.add(pr2);

  // pole line
  const pGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([new THREE.Vector3(0,0,0), new THREE.Vector3(0,-1.0,0)]);
  const pLine = new THREE.Line(pGeo, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:col, transparent:true, opacity:0.4}));
  grp.add(pLine);

  // hitbox
  const hGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.5,0.5,0.5);
  const hMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({visible:false});
  const hit = new THREE.Mesh(hGeo, hMat);
  hit.userData.incId = inc.id;
  grp.add(hit);

  incMarkers[inc.id] = {grp, diamond, dMat, pr, pr2, prMat, pr2Mat, inc, visible:true};
  return incMarkers[inc.id];
}
INCIDENTS.forEach(makeIncMarker);

// ─── RAYCASTER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();

canvas.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.set(
    ((e.clientX-rect.left)/rect.width)*2-1,
    -((e.clientY-rect.top)/rect.height)*2+1
  );
  raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);

  // Check incident markers first
  const incHits = [];
  Object.values(incMarkers).forEach(m => {
    if (!m.visible) return;
    m.grp.traverse(c => { if(c.userData.incId) incHits.push(c); });
  });
  let found = raycaster.intersectObjects(incHits);
  if (found.length) {
    const inc = INCIDENTS.find(i=>i.id===found[0].object.userData.incId);
    if (inc) { openIncident(inc); return; }
  }
});

// ─── CAMERA FLY-TO ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const CAM_DEFAULT = {px:0,py:12,pz:18,tx:0,ty:0,tz:0};
let flying = false;

function flyTo(camPos, target, dur, cb) {
  if (flying) return;
  flying = true;
  controls.enabled = false;
  const proxy = {t:0};
  gsap.to(proxy, {t:1, duration:dur||1.8, ease:'power3.inOut',
    onUpdate() {
      const α = proxy.t;
      camera.position.lerpVectors(
        new THREE.Vector3(camera.position.x, camera.position.y, camera.position.z),
        new THREE.Vector3(...camPos), α
      );
      controls.target.lerpVectors(controls.target, new THREE.Vector3(...target), α);
    },
    onComplete() {
      flying = false;
      controls.enabled = true;
      if(cb) cb();
    }
  });
}

function flyHome() {
  flyTo([CAM_DEFAULT.px,CAM_DEFAULT.py,CAM_DEFAULT.pz],[0,0,0],1.4);
}

// ─── PANEL ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const panel = document.getElementById('panel');
let activeInc = null;

function openIncident(inc) {
  activeInc = inc;

  // sev badge
  const sevEl = document.getElementById('panel-sev');
  sevEl.textContent = inc.sev;
  sevEl.style.background = SEV_COLORS[inc.sev]+'22';
  sevEl.style.color = SEV_COLORS[inc.sev];
  sevEl.style.border = '1px solid '+SEV_COLORS[inc.sev]+'44';

  document.getElementById('panel-title').textContent = inc.title;
  document.getElementById('panel-node').textContent = `${inc.id}  ·  Node: ${inc.node}  ·  ${inc.ts}  ·  Status: ${inc.status}`;

  // video
  document.getElementById('vid-ep-title').textContent = inc.title;
  document.getElementById('vid-emoji').textContent = inc.emoji;
  vidDur = inc.dur; vidProg = 0; vidPlaying = false;
  updateVidUI();
  populateChapters(inc.chapters);

  // chart
  updateChart();

  // audit timeline
  const tl = document.getElementById('audit-timeline');
  tl.innerHTML = inc.trail.map(s=>`
    <div class="aud-step">
      <div class="aud-icon" style="background:${s.color}22;color:${s.color}">${s.icon}</div>
      <div class="aud-body">
        <div class="aud-action">${s.action}</div>
        <div class="aud-time">${s.time}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');

  // logs
  const logEl = document.getElementById('log-entries');
  logEl.innerHTML = inc.logs.map(l=>`<div class="log-line ${l.cls}">${l.txt}</div>`).join('');

  panel.classList.add('open');

  // fly camera to node
  const nd = NODES.find(n=>n.id===inc.nodeId);
  if (nd) {
    const [x,,z] = nd.pos;
    flyTo([x+4, 5, z+6], [x,0.5,z], 1.6);
  }
}

function closePanel() {
  panel.classList.remove('open');
  activeInc = null;
  flyHome();
  stopVid();
}

document.getElementById('panel-close').addEventListener('click', closePanel);

// ─── CHART ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function updateChart() {
  const counts = {CRITICAL:0,HIGH:0,MEDIUM:0,LOW:0,INFO:0};
  INCIDENTS.forEach(i=>counts[i.sev]++);
  const max = Math.max(...Object.values(counts));
  const map = {CRITICAL:'crit',HIGH:'high',MEDIUM:'med',LOW:'low',INFO:'info'};
  Object.entries(counts).forEach(([sev,cnt])=>{
    const key = map[sev];
    document.getElementById('cb-'+key).style.width = max?`${(cnt/max)*100}%`:'0%';
    document.getElementById('cc-'+key).textContent = cnt;
  });
}
updateChart();

// ─── VIDEO PLAYER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let vidDur = 120, vidProg = 0, vidPlaying = false;
let vidRaf = null, vidLast = null;
let curChap = 0;

function fmtTime(s) {
  const m = Math.floor(s/60); const ss = Math.floor(s%60);
  return `${m}:${ss.toString().padStart(2,'0')}`;
}
function updateVidUI() {
  const pct = vidDur ? (vidProg/vidDur)*100 : 0;
  document.getElementById('prog-fill').style.width = pct+'%';
  document.getElementById('vid-time').textContent = `${fmtTime(vidProg)} / ${fmtTime(vidDur)}`;
  document.getElementById('vid-play').textContent = vidPlaying?'⏸':'▶';

  // chapter highlight
  if (activeInc) {
    const chaps = activeInc.chapters;
    let ci = 0;
    for (let i=0;i<chaps.length;i++) { if(vidProg>=chaps[i].s) ci=i; }
    curChap = ci;
    document.querySelectorAll('.chap').forEach((el,idx)=>el.classList.toggle('active',idx===ci));
  }
}
function playVid() {
  if (!vidPlaying) {
    if(vidProg>=vidDur) vidProg=0;
    vidPlaying=true; vidLast=performance.now();
    const tick = (now)=>{
      if(!vidPlaying) return;
      const dt=(now-vidLast)/1000; vidLast=now;
      vidProg=Math.min(vidProg+dt,vidDur);
      if(vidProg>=vidDur) { vidPlaying=false; }
      updateVidUI();
      vidRaf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    vidRaf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
}
function pauseVid() { vidPlaying=false; }
function stopVid() { vidPlaying=false; vidProg=0; if(vidRaf) cancelAnimationFrame(vidRaf); }
function prevChap() {
  if(!activeInc) return;
  const chaps=activeInc.chapters;
  const prev=curChap>0?curChap-1:0;
  vidProg=chaps[prev].s; updateVidUI();
}
function nextChap() {
  if(!activeInc) return;
  const chaps=activeInc.chapters;
  const next=Math.min(curChap+1,chaps.length-1);
  vidProg=chaps[next].s; updateVidUI();
}
function populateChapters(chaps) {
  const el=document.getElementById('chap-list');
  el.innerHTML=chaps.map((c,i)=>`<button class="chap" data-i="${i}">${c.t}</button>`).join('');
  el.querySelectorAll('.chap').forEach(b=>{
    b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      vidProg=chaps[+b.dataset.i].s; updateVidUI();
    });
  });
}
document.getElementById('vid-play').addEventListener('click',()=>{vidPlaying?pauseVid():playVid();updateVidUI();});
document.getElementById('vid-prev').addEventListener('click',prevChap);
document.getElementById('vid-next').addEventListener('click',nextChap);

const track = document.getElementById('prog-track');
let scrubbing = false;
function scrubAt(cx) {
  const rect=track.getBoundingClientRect();
  const ratio=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(cx-rect.left)/rect.width));
  vidProg=ratio*vidDur; updateVidUI();
}
track.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{scrubbing=true;scrubAt(e.clientX);});
window.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{if(scrubbing)scrubAt(e.clientX);});
window.addEventListener('mouseup',()=>{scrubbing=false;});

// ─── SEVERITY FILTERS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let activeSev = 'ALL';
document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn=>{
  btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    activeSev = btn.dataset.sev;
    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    applyFilter();
  });
});
function applyFilter() {
  Object.values(incMarkers).forEach(m=>{
    const show = activeSev==='ALL' || m.inc.sev===activeSev;
    m.visible = show;
    m.grp.visible = show;
  });
}

// ─── NODE LABELS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const labelsContainer = document.getElementById('labels');
const labelEls = {};
NODES.forEach(n=>{
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className='node-label';
  el.textContent=n.label;
  labelsContainer.appendChild(el);
  labelEls[n.id]=el;
});

const _v = new THREE.Vector3();
function updateLabels() {
  NODES.forEach(n=>{
    _v.set(...n.pos).project(camera);
    const x=(_v.x*0.5+0.5)*canvas.clientWidth;
    const y=(-_v.y*0.5+0.5)*canvas.clientHeight + 52;
    if (_v.z<1) {
      labelEls[n.id].style.display='block';
      labelEls[n.id].style.left=x+'px';
      labelEls[n.id].style.top=(y-38)+'px';
    } else {
      labelEls[n.id].style.display='none';
    }
  });
}

// ─── 2D TABLE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function populateTable() {
  const tbody=document.getElementById('inc-tbody');
  tbody.innerHTML=INCIDENTS.map(i=>{
    const col=SEV_COLORS[i.sev];
    return `<tr>
      <td>${i.id}</td>
      <td><span class="sev-badge" style="background:${col}22;color:${col};border:1px solid ${col}44">${i.sev}</span></td>
      <td>${i.title}</td>
      <td>${i.node}</td>
      <td>${i.ts}</td>
      <td>${i.status}</td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join('');
}
populateTable();

const view2d=document.getElementById('view2d');
let is2d=false;
document.getElementById('toggle2d').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  is2d=!is2d;
  view2d.style.display=is2d?'block':'none';
  document.getElementById('toggle2d').textContent=is2d?'3D View':'2D Table';
});

// ─── ANIMATION LOOP ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const clock = new THREE.Clock();
function resize() {
  const w=window.innerWidth, h=window.innerHeight;
  renderer.setSize(w,h);
  camera.aspect=w/h; camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize',resize);

function animate() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const t=clock.getElapsedTime();
  controls.update();

  // node body float + rotate
  NODES.forEach(n=>{
    const entry=nodeMap[n.id];
    if(!entry) return;
    entry.body.position.y = 0.55+Math.sin(t*1.2+n.pos[0])*0.04;
    entry.body.rotation.y += 0.003;
    // ring pulse
    const pulse=0.3+Math.sin(t*2+n.pos[0])*0.15;
    entry.ringMat.opacity=pulse*0.5;
  });

  // incident marker pulse
  Object.values(incMarkers).forEach(m=>{
    if(!m.visible) return;
    const st=t*2+m.inc.id.charCodeAt(4)*0.3;
    m.diamond.rotation.y=t*1.5;
    m.diamond.rotation.x=t*0.8;
    const scale=1+Math.sin(st)*0.12;
    m.grp.scale.setScalar(scale);
    m.prMat.opacity=0.4+Math.sin(st)*0.25;
    m.pr2Mat.opacity=0.15+Math.sin(st+1)*0.15;
  });

  updateLabels();
  renderer.render(scene,camera);
}
animate();

// ─── KEYBOARD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.key==='Escape'){closePanel();}
  if(e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();vidPlaying?pauseVid():playVid();updateVidUI();}
});
</script>
</body>

<script type="importmap">{"imports":{"three":"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.158.0/build/three.module.js","three/addons/":"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.158.0/examples/jsm/"}}</script>

<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
