  --accent:#6366f1;--accent2:#818cf8;--gold:#f59e0b;--font:system-ui,sans-serif
}
body{font-family:var(--font);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);overflow:hidden;height:100vh}
canvas{display:block}

/* NAV */
#nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:52px;background:rgba(7,9,15,0.9);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 1.25rem;gap:.75rem;z-index:50;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.nav-logo{font-weight:800;font-size:.9rem;letter-spacing:-.3px;margin-right:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--text)}
.logo-gem{width:26px;height:26px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));border-radius:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.8rem}
.nav-btn{padding:6px 14px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;letter-spacing:.04em}
.nav-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--text)}
.nav-btn.active{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
.nav-sep{width:1px;height:20px;background:var(--border)}
#date-badge{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.04em}

/* HUD CLOCK */
#hud{position:fixed;top:62px;left:1.25rem;z-index:20;pointer-events:none}
.hud-time{font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.5px;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(99,102,241,.6)}
.hud-date{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em;margin-top:2px}
.hud-live{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-top:4px;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.1em}
.live-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);animation:blink 1.4s infinite}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.3}}

/* SIDE PANEL */
#panel{position:fixed;top:52px;right:0;bottom:0;width:390px;background:var(--panel);border-left:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;flex-direction:column;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateX(24px);transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s;z-index:40;overflow:hidden}
#panel.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:all;transform:translateX(0)}
#panel-close{position:absolute;top:12px;right:14px;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px;z-index:2}
#panel-close:hover{color:var(--text)}

/* SESSION HEADER */
.session-head{padding:1.1rem 1rem .6rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
#sess-time-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:rgba(99,102,241,.12);border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,.25);border-radius:4px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent2);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.5rem}
#sess-title{font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:.25rem;letter-spacing:-.2px}
#sess-speaker{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}

/* VIDEO PLAYER */
.vid-wrap{background:#000;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.vid-screen{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;background:#000}
#vid-canvas{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.subtitle-bar{position:absolute;bottom:10px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:rgba(0,0,0,.75);color:#fff;font-size:.78rem;padding:4px 16px;border-radius:4px;max-width:90%;text-align:center;min-height:24px;transition:opacity .3s}
.vid-ctrl{padding:10px 12px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.prog-track{width:100%;height:4px;background:#1e293b;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px;position:relative}
.prog-fill{height:100%;border-radius:2px;background:var(--accent);pointer-events:none;transition:width .1s linear}
.ctrl-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.ctrl-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;font-size:.85rem;padding:3px;transition:color .15s}
.ctrl-btn:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.vid-time{font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted);margin-left:auto}
.cc-toggle{padding:2px 7px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:.62rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
.cc-toggle.on{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
.chap-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;padding:8px 12px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.chap-btn{padding:3px 9px;border-radius:3px;font-size:.62rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted);background:transparent;transition:all .15s}
.chap-btn:hover,.chap-btn.active{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}

/* AGENDA LIST */
.agenda-list{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:.75rem}
.agenda-label{font-size:.62rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:.5rem;padding:0 .25rem}
.agenda-item{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:10px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:6px;cursor:pointer;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);transition:all .15s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.agenda-item::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;border-radius:3px 0 0 3px}
.agenda-item:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-color:rgba(99,102,241,.3)}
.agenda-item.active{background:rgba(99,102,241,.08);border-color:rgba(99,102,241,.3)}
.ag-time{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);width:42px;flex-shrink:0;padding-top:2px}
.ag-dot{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.9rem;flex-shrink:0}
.ag-body{flex:1;min-width:0}
.ag-title{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.ag-meta{font-size:.67rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.ag-live{font-size:.55rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.08em;background:rgba(245,158,11,.12);padding:2px 5px;border-radius:2px;border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.2);margin-left:4px}

/* NOTIFICATIONS */
#notifs{position:fixed;bottom:1.5rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column-reverse;gap:8px;z-index:60;pointer-events:none;align-items:center}
.notif{background:rgba(12,16,32,.95);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 18px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text);white-space:nowrap;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4);opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}

/* 2D FALLBACK */
#view2d{position:fixed;top:52px;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:var(--bg);overflow-y:auto;display:none;z-index:30;padding:1.5rem}
.v2d-inner{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto}
.v2d-inner h2{font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:1rem}
.v2d-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:1rem;margin-bottom:.75rem;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s}
.v2d-card:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
.v2d-emoji{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.2rem;flex-shrink:0}
.v2d-body h4{font-size:.88rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:3px}
.v2d-body p{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted)}
.v2d-time{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);margin-top:4px}

/* NODE LABELS */
.node-lbl{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;color:rgba(226,232,240,.8);background:rgba(7,9,15,.8);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:3px;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.06em;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);z-index:20}

/* TOUR PROGRESS */
#tour-hud{position:fixed;bottom:1.5rem;right:1.5rem;display:none;background:rgba(12,16,32,.92);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:.75rem 1rem;z-index:50;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
#tour-hud.show{display:block}
.tour-step{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:.5rem}
.tour-title{font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:.75rem}
.tour-dots{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-bottom:.75rem}
.tour-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--border);transition:background .3s}
.tour-dot.active{background:var(--accent)}
.tour-btn{padding:6px 14px;border-radius:6px;border:none;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}

::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border);border-radius:2px}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  #panel,#panel.open{transition:none}
  .agenda-item,.notif,.chap-btn{transition:none}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav id="nav">
  <div class="nav-logo"><div class="logo-gem">✦</div>Summit 2024</div>
  <div id="date-badge">ANNUAL CORPORATE SUMMIT</div>
  <div class="nav-sep"></div>
  <button class="nav-btn" id="btn-tour">Guided Tour</button>
  <button class="nav-btn" id="btn-2d">2D Agenda</button>
  <button class="nav-btn" id="btn-home" title="Reset camera">⌂ Lobby</button>
</nav>

<!-- HUD -->
<div id="hud">
  <div class="hud-time" id="hud-time">09:00</div>
  <div class="hud-date">January 15, 2024</div>
  <div class="hud-live"><div class="live-dot"></div>LIVE</div>
</div>

<!-- 3D CANVAS -->
<canvas id="c"></canvas>

<!-- NODE LABELS CONTAINER -->
<div id="labels"></div>

<!-- NOTIFICATIONS -->
<div id="notifs"></div>

<!-- SIDE PANEL -->
<div id="panel">
  <button id="panel-close">✕</button>

  <div class="session-head">
    <div id="sess-time-badge">🕘 <span id="sess-time">09:00</span> · <span id="sess-room">Main Hall</span></div>
    <div id="sess-title">Opening Keynote</div>
    <div id="sess-speaker">Sarah Chen, CEO</div>
  </div>

  <div class="vid-wrap">
    <div class="vid-screen">
      <canvas id="vid-canvas"></canvas>
      <div class="subtitle-bar" id="subtitle-bar"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="vid-ctrl">
      <div class="prog-track" id="prog-track"><div class="prog-fill" id="prog-fill"></div></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row">
        <button class="ctrl-btn" id="vid-prev">⏮</button>
        <button class="ctrl-btn" id="vid-play">▶</button>
        <button class="ctrl-btn" id="vid-next">⏭</button>
        <span class="vid-time" id="vid-time-lbl">0:00 / 0:00</span>
        <button class="cc-toggle on" id="cc-btn">CC</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="chap-bar" id="chap-bar"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="agenda-list">
    <div class="agenda-label">Today's Schedule</div>
    <div id="agenda-list"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- 2D VIEW -->
<div id="view2d">
  <div class="v2d-inner">
    <h2>📅 Today's Agenda</h2>
    <div id="v2d-list"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- TOUR HUD -->
<div id="tour-hud">
  <div class="tour-step" id="tour-step">Step 1 of 5</div>
  <div class="tour-title" id="tour-title">Welcome</div>
  <div class="tour-dots" id="tour-dots"></div>
  <button class="tour-btn" id="tour-next">Next →</button>
</div>

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

// ─── SESSIONS DATA ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const SESSIONS = [
  {
    id:'S1', time:'09:00', title:'Opening Keynote', speaker:'Sarah Chen, CEO',
    room:'Main Hall', dur:90, emoji:'🎤', color:'#6366f1',
    live:true, pos:[0, 2.8, -9.5],
    chapters:[{t:'Welcome',s:0},{t:'Vision 2024',s:30},{t:'Strategy',s:60},{t:'Q&A',s:80}],
    subtitles:['Welcome to Summit 2024.','This year, we redefine what\'s possible.','Our vision: lead the industry into the next era.','Together, we will shape the future.'],
    desc:'Annual opening keynote setting the strategic vision for 2024.'
  },
  {
    id:'S2', time:'10:30', title:'Product Strategy Workshop', speaker:'Marcus Webb, CPO',
    room:'Room A', dur:75, emoji:'💡', color:'#34d399',
    live:false, pos:[-5, 2, -5],
    chapters:[{t:'Roadmap',s:0},{t:'Priorities',s:25},{t:'Demo',s:50},{t:'Feedback',s:65}],
    subtitles:['Let\'s review the product roadmap.','These are our Q1 priorities.','Watch the live demo.','We need your feedback now.'],
    desc:'Deep-dive into product direction, priorities, and customer feedback loops.'
  },
  {
    id:'S3', time:'14:00', title:'Leadership Roundtable', speaker:'Panel Discussion',
    room:'Room B', dur:60, emoji:'🗣', color:'#f59e0b',
    live:false, pos:[5, 2, -5],
    chapters:[{t:'Intros',s:0},{t:'Challenges',s:15},{t:'Solutions',s:35},{t:'Vision',s:50}],
    subtitles:['Let\'s introduce our panelists.','What are the key challenges?','Here are the proposed solutions.','A shared vision for leadership.'],
    desc:'Executive panel exploring leadership challenges in a rapidly evolving market.'
  },
  {
    id:'S4', time:'15:30', title:'Innovation Showcase', speaker:'Engineering Team',
    room:'Room C', dur:45, emoji:'🚀', color:'#f472b6',
    live:false, pos:[-4.5, 2, -7],
    chapters:[{t:'Projects',s:0},{t:'AI Tools',s:15},{t:'Demos',s:30},{t:'Awards',s:40}],
    subtitles:['Meet our innovation projects.','AI tools changing how we work.','Live demonstrations from the team.','And the innovation award goes to…'],
    desc:'Engineering and product teams showcase this year\'s most exciting innovations.'
  },
  {
    id:'S5', time:'17:00', title:'Networking Reception', speaker:'All Attendees',
    room:'Lobby', dur:120, emoji:'🤝', color:'#38bdf8',
    live:false, pos:[4.5, 2, -7],
    chapters:[{t:'Welcome',s:0},{t:'Mixer',s:20},{t:'Awards',s:80},{t:'Closing',s:110}],
    subtitles:['Welcome to the networking reception!','Time to connect with colleagues.','Now presenting the annual awards.','Thank you for joining Summit 2024.'],
    desc:'Casual networking with drinks, awards ceremony, and closing remarks.'
  },
];

// ─── TOUR STEPS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const TOUR = [
  {title:'Welcome Screen', desc:'The main screen plays the welcome video for Summit 2024.', cam:[0,4,10], tgt:[0,3,-8]},
  {title:'Keynote Stage',  desc:'Session S1 — Opening Keynote by CEO Sarah Chen.', cam:[2,3.5,1], tgt:SESSIONS[0].pos},
  {title:'Workshop Rooms', desc:'Side rooms host workshops and roundtable discussions.', cam:[-6,4,0], tgt:[-5,2,-5]},
  {title:'Innovation Zone', desc:'The engineering team showcases this year\'s innovations.', cam:[-3,4,-3], tgt:SESSIONS[3].pos},
  {title:'Reception Area',  desc:'End the day at the networking reception — grab a drink!', cam:[5,4,-3], tgt:SESSIONS[4].pos},
];

// ─── RENDERER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const canvas3d = document.getElementById('c');
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas:canvas3d, antialias:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio,2));
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
renderer.toneMappingExposure = 0.9;

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x07090f);
scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x07090f, 22, 40);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55, 1, 0.1, 100);
camera.position.set(0, 3.5, 12);

const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, canvas3d);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.dampingFactor = 0.07;
controls.target.set(0, 2, 0);
controls.minDistance = 2;
controls.maxDistance = 28;
controls.maxPolarAngle = Math.PI * 0.5;

// ─── LIGHTS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x0d1020, 4));

const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x1a2050, 0x050810, 1.5);
scene.add(hemi);

function makeSpot(x, y, z, color, intensity, dist) {
  const s = new THREE.SpotLight(color, intensity, dist, Math.PI/5, 0.4);
  s.position.set(x,y,z);
  s.castShadow = true;
  s.shadow.mapSize.set(512,512);
  scene.add(s); scene.add(s.target);
  s.target.position.set(x, 0, z);
  return s;
}
makeSpot(0, 7, -8, 0x8090ff, 4, 20);
makeSpot(-5, 7, -3, 0x5060c0, 2.5, 14);
makeSpot(5, 7, -3, 0x5060c0, 2.5, 14);
makeSpot(0, 6, 3, 0x7080d0, 2, 14);

// Accent accent color lamps on desk
const deskPt = new THREE.PointLight(0x6366f1, 2, 8);
deskPt.position.set(0, 1.5, 2);
scene.add(deskPt);

// Screen glow
const screenPt = new THREE.PointLight(0x4a50ff, 1.5, 12);
screenPt.position.set(0, 3.5, -12);
scene.add(screenPt);

// ─── FLOOR ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function makeFloorTex() {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = 512; c.height = 512;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle = '#080c18';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,512,512);
  // grid lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(99,102,241,0.12)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for(let i=0;i<=512;i+=64){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(i,0);ctx.lineTo(i,512);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,i);ctx.lineTo(512,i);ctx.stroke();
  }
  return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
}
const floorTex = makeFloorTex();
floorTex.wrapS = floorTex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
floorTex.repeat.set(6,6);
const floorMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(28, 28),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({map:floorTex, roughness:0.3, metalness:0.5})
);
floorMesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
floorMesh.receiveShadow = true;
scene.add(floorMesh);

// ─── CEILING ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const ceilMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(28, 28),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x080c18, roughness:1})
);
ceilMesh.rotation.x = Math.PI/2;
ceilMesh.position.y = 8;
scene.add(ceilMesh);

// Ceiling light strips
for(let i=-1;i<=1;i++) {
  const strip = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.15, 0.05, 12),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xaab4ff})
  );
  strip.position.set(i*4, 7.95, -4);
  scene.add(strip);
  // light panel glow
  const glow = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.3, 12),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x6366f1, transparent:true, opacity:0.08, side:THREE.DoubleSide})
  );
  glow.position.set(i*4, 7.6, -4);
  scene.add(glow);
}

// ─── WALLS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const wallMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x0a0f1e, roughness:0.8, metalness:0.1});
// back wall
const backWall = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(24, 8), wallMat);
backWall.position.set(0, 4, -14);
scene.add(backWall);
// side walls
const leftWall = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(28, 8), wallMat.clone());
leftWall.rotation.y = Math.PI/2;
leftWall.position.set(-12, 4, 0);
scene.add(leftWall);
const rightWall = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(28, 8), wallMat.clone());
rightWall.rotation.y = -Math.PI/2;
rightWall.position.set(12, 4, 0);
scene.add(rightWall);

// Wall accent strip (glowing baseboard)
function makeWallStrip(x, y, z, w, h, d, color) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color, transparent:true, opacity:0.6})
  );
  m.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(m);
}
makeWallStrip(0, 0.03, -13.9, 20, 0.06, 0.1, 0x6366f1);
makeWallStrip(-11.9, 0.03, 0, 0.1, 0.06, 28, 0x6366f1);
makeWallStrip(11.9, 0.03, 0, 0.1, 0.06, 28, 0x6366f1);

// ─── COLUMNS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const colPositions = [[-4,0,-4],[4,0,-4],[-4,0,-10],[4,0,-10]];
colPositions.forEach(([x,,z])=>{
  const col = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.3, 0.35, 8, 16),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x0e1530, metalness:0.6, roughness:0.3})
  );
  col.position.set(x,4,z);
  col.castShadow = true;
  scene.add(col);
  // glow band
  const band = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.32, 0.32, 0.12, 16),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x6366f1, transparent:true, opacity:0.7})
  );
  band.position.set(x, 0.7, z);
  scene.add(band);
  const band2 = band.clone();
  band2.position.set(x, 7.3, z);
  scene.add(band2);
});

// ─── RECEPTION DESK ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const deskGroup = new THREE.Group();
const deskBody = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.BoxGeometry(5, 1.05, 1.4),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x0c1428, metalness:0.5, roughness:0.4})
);
deskBody.position.y = 0.525;
deskGroup.add(deskBody);
// desk top
const deskTop = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.BoxGeometry(5.1, 0.06, 1.5),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x1a2548, metalness:0.8, roughness:0.2})
);
deskTop.position.y = 1.08;
deskGroup.add(deskTop);
// desk glow strip
const deskGlow = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.BoxGeometry(4.9, 0.04, 0.04),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x6366f1, transparent:true, opacity:0.9})
);
deskGlow.position.set(0, 0.5, 0.68);
deskGroup.add(deskGlow);
deskGroup.position.set(0, 0, 2);
scene.add(deskGroup);

// ─── MAIN SCREEN ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const screenCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
screenCanvas.width = 1024; screenCanvas.height = 576;
const screenCtx = screenCanvas.getContext('2d');
const screenTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(screenCanvas);

const screenMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(9, 5.06),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:screenTex})
);
screenMesh.position.set(0, 4.8, -13.85);
scene.add(screenMesh);

// screen frame
const frameMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.BoxGeometry(9.4, 5.46, 0.08),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x0d1428, metalness:0.7, roughness:0.3})
);
frameMesh.position.set(0, 4.8, -13.9);
scene.add(frameMesh);

// screen glow border
const glowBorder = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(9.6, 5.7),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x4a50ff, transparent:true, opacity:0.06, side:THREE.DoubleSide})
);
glowBorder.position.set(0, 4.8, -13.82);
scene.add(glowBorder);

// ─── SESSION PANEL MESHES ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const panelMeshes = [];
const panelHitboxes = [];

function makePanelTex(sess) {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = 320; c.height = 480;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');

  // background
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0c1020';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,320,480);

  // color accent line
  ctx.fillStyle = sess.color;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,320,4);

  // glow overlay
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,120);
  grad.addColorStop(0, sess.color+'44');
  grad.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,320,120);

  // emoji
  ctx.font = '52px serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(sess.emoji, 160, 80);

  // time
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px system-ui';
  ctx.fillStyle = sess.color;
  ctx.fillText(sess.time, 160, 120);

  // title
  ctx.font = 'bold 22px system-ui';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e2e8f0';
  // word wrap
  const words = sess.title.split(' ');
  let line='', y=158;
  for(const w of words){
    const test = line ? line+' '+w : w;
    if(ctx.measureText(test).width > 280 && line) {
      ctx.fillText(line, 160, y); line=w; y+=28;
    } else line = test;
  }
  ctx.fillText(line, 160, y); y+=28;

  // speaker
  ctx.font = '15px system-ui';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
  ctx.fillText(sess.speaker, 160, y+10);

  // room
  ctx.font = '13px system-ui';
  ctx.fillStyle = sess.color+'bb';
  ctx.fillText('📍 '+sess.room, 160, y+36);

  // duration
  ctx.font = '13px system-ui';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#475569';
  ctx.fillText(`${sess.dur} min`, 160, y+56);

  // live badge
  if(sess.live) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b22';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(110, y+70, 100, 24, 4); ctx.fill();
    ctx.font = 'bold 11px system-ui';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b';
    ctx.fillText('● LIVE NOW', 160, y+86);
  }

  // click hint
  ctx.font = '12px system-ui';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#334155';
  ctx.fillText('Click to watch', 160, 450);

  // border
  ctx.strokeStyle = sess.color+'44';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.strokeRect(1,1,318,478);

  return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
}

SESSIONS.forEach(sess => {
  const tex = makePanelTex(sess);
  const panelMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.4, 2.1),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:tex, transparent:true})
  );
  panelMesh.position.set(...sess.pos);
  panelMesh.userData.sessId = sess.id;
  scene.add(panelMesh);
  panelMeshes.push(panelMesh);

  // frame glow
  const glowPlane = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.6, 2.3),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:new THREE.Color(sess.color), transparent:true, opacity:0.06})
  );
  glowPlane.position.set(sess.pos[0], sess.pos[1], sess.pos[2]-0.01);
  scene.add(glowPlane);

  // invisible hitbox
  const hit = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.5, 2.2, 0.1),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({visible:false})
  );
  hit.position.set(...sess.pos);
  hit.userData.sessId = sess.id;
  scene.add(hit);
  panelHitboxes.push(hit);

  // pole
  const pole = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.015, 0.015, sess.pos[1]-0.05, 8),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x334155})
  );
  pole.position.set(sess.pos[0], sess.pos[1]/2, sess.pos[2]);
  scene.add(pole);
});

// ─── RAYCASTER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();

canvas3d.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const r = canvas3d.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.set(((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*2-1, -((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height)*2+1);
  raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);
  const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(panelHitboxes);
  if (hits.length) {
    const sid = hits[0].object.userData.sessId;
    const sess = SESSIONS.find(s=>s.id===sid);
    if(sess) openSession(sess);
  }
});

// ─── CAMERA FLY-TO ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let flying = false;
function flyTo(camPos, tgt, dur=1.8, cb) {
  if(flying) return;
  flying = true;
  controls.enabled = false;
  const proxy = {t:0};
  const startCam = camera.position.clone();
  const startTgt = controls.target.clone();
  const endCam = new THREE.Vector3(...camPos);
  const endTgt = new THREE.Vector3(...tgt);
  gsap.to(proxy, {t:1, duration:dur, ease:'power3.inOut',
    onUpdate() {
      camera.position.lerpVectors(startCam, endCam, proxy.t);
      controls.target.lerpVectors(startTgt, endTgt, proxy.t);
    },
    onComplete() {
      flying = false;
      controls.enabled = true;
      if(cb) cb();
    }
  });
}

function flyHome() {
  flyTo([0,3.5,12],[0,2,0],1.5);
}

// ─── PANEL ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const sidePanel = document.getElementById('panel');
let activeSess = null;

function openSession(sess) {
  activeSess = sess;
  document.getElementById('sess-time').textContent = sess.time;
  document.getElementById('sess-room').textContent = sess.room;
  document.getElementById('sess-title').textContent = sess.title;
  document.getElementById('sess-speaker').textContent = sess.speaker;

  // chapters
  const bar = document.getElementById('chap-bar');
  bar.innerHTML = sess.chapters.map((c,i)=>`<button class="chap-btn" data-i="${i}">${c.t}</button>`).join('');
  bar.querySelectorAll('.chap-btn').forEach(b=>{
    b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      vidProg = sess.chapters[+b.dataset.i].s;
      updateVidUI();
    });
  });

  // agenda highlight
  document.querySelectorAll('.agenda-item').forEach(el=>{
    el.classList.toggle('active', el.dataset.sid===sess.id);
  });

  // video reset
  vidDur = sess.dur; vidProg = 0; vidPlaying = false;
  updateVidUI();

  sidePanel.classList.add('open');

  // fly camera near panel
  const [px, py, pz] = sess.pos;
  flyTo([px+3.5, py+1, pz+5], [px, py, pz], 1.6);

  showNotif(`${sess.emoji} Now playing: ${sess.title}`);
}

function closePanel() {
  sidePanel.classList.remove('open');
  activeSess = null;
  stopVid();
  flyHome();
  document.querySelectorAll('.agenda-item').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('active'));
}
document.getElementById('panel-close').addEventListener('click', closePanel);

// ─── VIDEO PLAYER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const vidCanvas = document.getElementById('vid-canvas');
const vidCtx = vidCanvas.getContext('2d');
vidCanvas.width = 640; vidCanvas.height = 360;

let vidDur = 90, vidProg = 0, vidPlaying = false;
let vidRaf = null, vidLast = null;
let ccOn = true, curChap = 0;

function fmtTime(s){ const m=Math.floor(s/60); return `${m}:${Math.floor(s%60).toString().padStart(2,'0')}`; }

function updateVidUI() {
  const pct = vidDur ? (vidProg/vidDur)*100 : 0;
  document.getElementById('prog-fill').style.width = pct+'%';
  document.getElementById('vid-time-lbl').textContent = `${fmtTime(vidProg)} / ${fmtTime(vidDur)}`;
  document.getElementById('vid-play').textContent = vidPlaying ? '⏸' : '▶';

  if(activeSess) {
    const chaps = activeSess.chapters;
    let ci = 0;
    for(let i=0;i<chaps.length;i++) { if(vidProg>=chaps[i].s) ci=i; }
    curChap = ci;
    document.querySelectorAll('.chap-btn').forEach((el,idx)=>el.classList.toggle('active',idx===ci));

    // subtitle
    if(ccOn && activeSess.subtitles) {
      const si = Math.floor((vidProg/vidDur)*activeSess.subtitles.length) % activeSess.subtitles.length;
      document.getElementById('subtitle-bar').textContent = activeSess.subtitles[si];
    } else {
      document.getElementById('subtitle-bar').textContent = '';
    }
  }
  drawVidFrame();
}

function drawVidFrame() {
  if(!activeSess) return;
  const ctx = vidCtx;
  const w=640, h=360;
  const col = activeSess.color;

  // background gradient
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,h);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#07090f');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#0c1020');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);

  // scanline animation
  const scanY = (vidProg*30) % h;
  ctx.fillStyle = col+'18';
  ctx.fillRect(0, scanY, w, 3);

  // grid
  ctx.strokeStyle = col+'1a';
  ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let x=0;x<w;x+=40){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x,h);ctx.stroke();}
  for(let y=0;y<h;y+=40){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(w,y);ctx.stroke();}

  // emoji
  ctx.font='64px serif';
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
  ctx.fillText(activeSess.emoji, w/2, h/2+10);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // session title
  ctx.font='bold 22px system-ui';
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.fillText(activeSess.title, w/2, h/2-50);

  // speaker
  ctx.font='14px system-ui';
  ctx.fillStyle='#94a3b8';
  ctx.fillText(activeSess.speaker, w/2, h/2+55);

  // chapter label
  if(activeSess.chapters[curChap]) {
    ctx.font='bold 12px system-ui';
    ctx.fillStyle=col;
    ctx.fillText('▶ '+activeSess.chapters[curChap].t, w/2, h-28);
  }

  // progress overlay
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.4)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,h-14,w,14);
  ctx.fillStyle=col;
  ctx.fillRect(0,h-14,(vidProg/vidDur)*w,14);

  // time label
  ctx.font='11px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillText(fmtTime(vidProg), w-12, h-3);
}

function playVid(){
  if(!vidPlaying){
    if(vidProg>=vidDur) vidProg=0;
    vidPlaying=true; vidLast=performance.now();
    const tick=(now)=>{
      if(!vidPlaying) return;
      const dt=(now-vidLast)/1000; vidLast=now;
      vidProg=Math.min(vidProg+dt,vidDur);
      if(vidProg>=vidDur){vidPlaying=false;}
      updateVidUI();
      vidRaf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    vidRaf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
}
function pauseVid(){vidPlaying=false;}
function stopVid(){vidPlaying=false;vidProg=0;if(vidRaf)cancelAnimationFrame(vidRaf);}
function prevChap(){
  if(!activeSess) return;
  const c=activeSess.chapters;
  vidProg=c[Math.max(0,curChap-1)].s; updateVidUI();
}
function nextChap(){
  if(!activeSess) return;
  const c=activeSess.chapters;
  vidProg=c[Math.min(curChap+1,c.length-1)].s; updateVidUI();
}

document.getElementById('vid-play').addEventListener('click',()=>{vidPlaying?pauseVid():playVid();updateVidUI();});
document.getElementById('vid-prev').addEventListener('click',prevChap);
document.getElementById('vid-next').addEventListener('click',nextChap);
document.getElementById('cc-btn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  ccOn=!ccOn;
  document.getElementById('cc-btn').classList.toggle('on',ccOn);
  updateVidUI();
});

const progTrack = document.getElementById('prog-track');
let scrubbing=false;
function scrubAt(cx){
  const r=progTrack.getBoundingClientRect();
  const pct=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(cx-r.left)/r.width));
  vidProg=pct*vidDur; updateVidUI();
}
progTrack.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{scrubbing=true;scrubAt(e.clientX);});
window.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{if(scrubbing)scrubAt(e.clientX);});
window.addEventListener('mouseup',()=>{scrubbing=false;});

// ─── AGENDA LIST ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function buildAgendaList() {
  const el = document.getElementById('agenda-list');
  el.innerHTML = SESSIONS.map(s=>`
    <div class="agenda-item" data-sid="${s.id}" style="--c:${s.color}">
      <style>.agenda-item[data-sid="${s.id}"]::before{background:${s.color}}</style>
      <div class="ag-time">${s.time}</div>
      <div class="ag-dot" style="background:${s.color}22">${s.emoji}</div>
      <div class="ag-body">
        <div class="ag-title">${s.title}${s.live?'<span class="ag-live">LIVE</span>':''}</div>
        <div class="ag-meta">${s.speaker} · ${s.dur}m · ${s.room}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');
  el.querySelectorAll('.agenda-item').forEach(item=>{
    item.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      const sess=SESSIONS.find(s=>s.id===item.dataset.sid);
      if(sess) openSession(sess);
    });
  });
}
buildAgendaList();

// ─── 2D FALLBACK ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const v2dList = document.getElementById('v2d-list');
v2dList.innerHTML = SESSIONS.map(s=>`
  <div class="v2d-card" onclick="document.getElementById('btn-2d').click()">
    <div class="v2d-emoji" style="background:${s.color}22">${s.emoji}</div>
    <div class="v2d-body">
      <h4>${s.title}${s.live?` <span style="font-size:.6rem;color:#f59e0b;background:#f59e0b22;padding:2px 5px;border-radius:3px">LIVE</span>`:''}</h4>
      <p>${s.speaker} · ${s.room}</p>
      <div class="v2d-time">${s.time} · ${s.dur} min</div>
    </div>
  </div>`).join('');

let is2d=false;
document.getElementById('btn-2d').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  is2d=!is2d;
  document.getElementById('view2d').style.display=is2d?'block':'none';
  document.getElementById('btn-2d').textContent=is2d?'3D View':'2D Agenda';
  document.getElementById('btn-2d').classList.toggle('active',is2d);
});

// ─── NOTIFICATIONS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const notifContainer = document.getElementById('notifs');
function showNotif(msg) {
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className='notif';
  el.textContent = msg;
  notifContainer.appendChild(el);
  gsap.to(el,{opacity:1,y:0,duration:.35,ease:'back.out(1.5)'});
  setTimeout(()=>{
    gsap.to(el,{opacity:0,y:8,duration:.3,onComplete:()=>el.remove()});
  },3200);
}

// ─── GUIDED TOUR ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let tourActive=false, tourStep=0;
const tourHud=document.getElementById('tour-hud');

function buildTourDots(){
  const d=document.getElementById('tour-dots');
  d.innerHTML=TOUR.map((_,i)=>`<div class="tour-dot ${i===tourStep?'active':''}"></div>`).join('');
}
function runTourStep(){
  const step=TOUR[tourStep];
  document.getElementById('tour-step').textContent=`Step ${tourStep+1} of ${TOUR.length}`;
  document.getElementById('tour-title').textContent=step.title;
  buildTourDots();
  flyTo(step.cam, step.tgt, 1.6);
  showNotif(`🗺 ${step.title}: ${step.desc}`);
}
document.getElementById('tour-next').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  tourStep++;
  if(tourStep>=TOUR.length){
    tourActive=false; tourHud.classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('btn-tour').classList.remove('active');
    flyHome();
    showNotif('✅ Tour complete! Explore freely.');
    return;
  }
  document.getElementById('tour-next').textContent = tourStep===TOUR.length-1?'Finish':'Next →';
  runTourStep();
});
document.getElementById('btn-tour').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(tourActive){
    tourActive=false; tourHud.classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('btn-tour').classList.remove('active');
    flyHome(); return;
  }
  tourActive=true; tourStep=0;
  tourHud.classList.add('show');
  document.getElementById('btn-tour').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('tour-next').textContent='Next →';
  runTourStep();
});
document.getElementById('btn-home').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  closePanel();
  showNotif('🏛 Returned to lobby');
});

// ─── NODE LABELS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const labelsContainer = document.getElementById('labels');
const labelEls = {};
SESSIONS.forEach(s=>{
  const el=document.createElement('div');
  el.className='node-lbl';
  el.textContent=s.title;
  labelsContainer.appendChild(el);
  labelEls[s.id]=el;
});

const _v3 = new THREE.Vector3();
function updateLabels(){
  SESSIONS.forEach(s=>{
    _v3.set(...s.pos).project(camera);
    const x=(_v3.x*.5+.5)*canvas3d.clientWidth;
    const y=(-_v3.y*.5+.5)*canvas3d.clientHeight+52;
    const el=labelEls[s.id];
    if(_v3.z<1){el.style.display='block';el.style.left=x+'px';el.style.top=(y-54)+'px';}
    else{el.style.display='none';}
  });
}

// ─── CLOCK HUD ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function updateClock(){
  const n=new Date();
  document.getElementById('hud-time').textContent=
    n.getHours().toString().padStart(2,'0')+':'+n.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2,'0');
}
updateClock();
setInterval(updateClock, 15000);

// ─── MAIN SCREEN ANIMATION ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let welcomeT = 0;
function drawWelcomeScreen(t){
  const ctx=screenCtx, w=1024, h=576;
  // bg
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,w,h);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#07090f'); g.addColorStop(1,'#0c1028');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);

  // scan line
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(99,102,241,0.06)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,(t*40)%h,w,4);

  // grid
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(99,102,241,0.07)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let x=0;x<w;x+=64){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x,h);ctx.stroke();}
  for(let y=0;y<h;y+=64){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(w,y);ctx.stroke();}

  // logo pulse
  const pulse=0.9+Math.sin(t*1.5)*0.1;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(w/2, h/2-60);
  ctx.scale(pulse,pulse);
  ctx.font='bold 68px system-ui';
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('SUMMIT 2024', 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();

  // subtitle
  ctx.font='26px system-ui';
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('Annual Corporate Conference', w/2, h/2+20);

  // accent underline
  const uw=320, ux=w/2-uw/2;
  ctx.fillStyle='#6366f1';
  ctx.fillRect(ux, h/2+38, uw*(0.5+Math.sin(t*0.5)*0.5), 2);

  // date
  ctx.font='18px system-ui';
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
  ctx.fillText('January 15, 2024 · Main Auditorium', w/2, h/2+70);

  // live indicator
  const alpha=0.5+Math.sin(t*3)*0.5;
  ctx.font='bold 14px system-ui';
  ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(245,158,11,${alpha})`;
  ctx.fillText('● LIVE', w/2, h/2+105);

  // bottom bar progress
  const prog=(t%60)/60;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.06)';
  ctx.fillRect(80,h-28,w-160,4);
  ctx.fillStyle='#6366f1';
  ctx.fillRect(80,h-28,(w-160)*prog,4);

  // CC sub
  ctx.font='18px system-ui';
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
  const subs=['Welcome to Summit 2024.','Explore, connect, and innovate.','Your journey starts here.'];
  const si=Math.floor(t/5)%subs.length;
  const subtitleBg=ctx.createRoundRect?undefined:null;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
  const st=subs[si]; const tw=ctx.measureText(st).width;
  ctx.fillRect(w/2-tw/2-12,h-58,tw+24,26);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
  ctx.fillText(st, w/2, h-40);

  screenTex.needsUpdate=true;
}

// ─── PANEL FLOAT ANIMATION ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const panelBaseY = SESSIONS.map(s=>s.pos[1]);

// ─── RESIZE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function resize(){
  const w=window.innerWidth, h=window.innerHeight;
  renderer.setSize(w,h);
  camera.aspect=w/h; camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
resize(); window.addEventListener('resize',resize);

// ─── RENDER LOOP ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const clock = new THREE.Clock();
function animate(){
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const t=clock.getElapsedTime();
  controls.update();

  // welcome screen
  drawWelcomeScreen(t);

  // panel float
  panelMeshes.forEach((m,i)=>{
    m.position.y = panelBaseY[i] + Math.sin(t*0.8+i*1.2)*0.06;
    m.rotation.y = Math.sin(t*0.3+i*0.7)*0.04;
    panelHitboxes[i].position.copy(m.position);
  });

  // column band pulse
  deskPt.intensity = 1.8 + Math.sin(t*1.5)*0.5;

  updateLabels();
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
animate();

// ─── KEYBOARD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.key==='Escape') closePanel();
  if(e.key===' '){e.preventDefault(); vidPlaying?pauseVid():playVid(); updateVidUI();}
  if(e.key==='ArrowRight') nextChap();
  if(e.key==='ArrowLeft') prevChap();
});

// Boot notification
setTimeout(()=>showNotif('🏛 Welcome to Summit 2024 — click any panel to start a session'), 800);
</script>

renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio,2));
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
renderer.toneMappingExposure = 0.8;

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x06080e);
scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x06080e, 0.03);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(52, 1, 0.1, 80);
camera.position.set(0, 2, 15);

const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, canvas3d);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.dampingFactor = 0.07;
controls.target.set(0, 0, 0);
controls.minDistance = 4;
controls.maxDistance = 28;
controls.maxPolarAngle = Math.PI * 0.52;

// ─── LIGHTS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x0a0e1e, 5));
const dir = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x6070c0, 1.5);
dir.position.set(3, 10, 5);
dir.castShadow = true;

// Per-widget accent lights (set up later)
const widgetLights = {};

// ─── FLOOR GRID ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

gridHelper.position.y = -3.5;

// ─── CANVAS TEXTURE DRAWING ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
let activePeriod = 'Q4';

function clearCanvas(ctx, w, h, color='#0b0f1e') {
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
}

function drawKpiCard(ctx, w, h, widget, data) {
  clearCanvas(ctx, w, h);
  const col = widget.color;
  // top accent bar
  ctx.fillStyle = col;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,4);
  // gradient overlay
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,h*.6);
  g.addColorStop(0,col+'33'); g.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h*.6);
  // emoji
  ctx.font=`${Math.round(h*.2)}px serif`;
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText(widget.emoji, w*.78, h*.32);
  // label
  ctx.font=`bold ${Math.round(h*.08)}px system-ui`;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,116,139,0.9)';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText(widget.title.toUpperCase(), w*.06, h*.18);
  // main value
  ctx.font=`900 ${Math.round(h*.26)}px system-ui`;
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText(data.main || '—', w*.06, h*.5);
  // delta
  ctx.font=`bold ${Math.round(h*.09)}px system-ui`;
  ctx.fillStyle=col;
  ctx.fillText('▲ '+widget.getKpi(PERIODS[activePeriod]).delta, w*.06, h*.64);
  // sparkline
  const weekly=PERIODS[activePeriod].weekly;
  const sx=w*.06, sy=h*.75, sw=w*.88, sh=h*.2;
  ctx.strokeStyle=col+'99'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  weekly.forEach((v,i)=>{
    const nx=sx+i*(sw/(weekly.length-1));
    const ny=sy+sh-((v-Math.min(...weekly))/(Math.max(...weekly)-Math.min(...weekly)))*sh;
    i===0?ctx.moveTo(nx,ny):ctx.lineTo(nx,ny);
  });
  ctx.stroke();
  // sparkline fill
  ctx.fillStyle=col+'22';
  ctx.beginPath();
  weekly.forEach((v,i)=>{
    const nx=sx+i*(sw/(weekly.length-1));
    const ny=sy+sh-((v-Math.min(...weekly))/(Math.max(...weekly)-Math.min(...weekly)))*sh;
    i===0?ctx.moveTo(nx,ny):ctx.lineTo(nx,ny);
  });
  ctx.lineTo(sx+sw, sy+sh); ctx.lineTo(sx, sy+sh);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // border
  ctx.strokeStyle=col+'55'; ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
  ctx.strokeRect(1,1,w-2,h-2);
}

function drawBarChart(ctx, w, h, widget, data) {
  clearCanvas(ctx, w, h);
  const col=widget.color, weekly=data.weekly;
  ctx.fillStyle=col; ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,4);
  ctx.font=`bold ${Math.round(h*.065)}px system-ui`;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,116,139,0.85)';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText(widget.title.toUpperCase(), w*.04, h*.13);
  ctx.font=`900 ${Math.round(h*.14)}px system-ui`;
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.fillText(data.revenue||data.main||'—', w*.04, h*.26);

  const sx=w*.04, sy=h*.32, sw=w*.92, sh=h*.54;
  const barW=sw/weekly.length*0.65, gap=sw/weekly.length*0.35;
  const maxV=Math.max(...weekly)+0.2;
  const months=['S','O','N','D','J','F','M','A','M'].slice(0,weekly.length);

  weekly.forEach((v,i)=>{
    const bh=(v/maxV)*sh;
    const bx=sx+i*(sw/weekly.length)+gap/2;
    const by=sy+sh-bh;
    // bar bg
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
    ctx.fillRect(bx, sy, barW, sh);
    // bar fill
    const bg=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,by,0,by+bh);
    bg.addColorStop(0,col); bg.addColorStop(1,col+'66');
    ctx.fillStyle=bg;
    ctx.fillRect(bx, by, barW, bh);
    // value label on tall bars
    if(i===weekly.length-1||i===weekly.length-3){
      ctx.font=`bold ${Math.round(h*.045)}px system-ui`;
      ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
      ctx.textAlign='center';
      ctx.fillText('$'+v.toFixed(1), bx+barW/2, by-5);
    }
    // x label
    ctx.font=`${Math.round(h*.045)}px system-ui`;
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,116,139,.8)';
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText(months[i]||'', bx+barW/2, sy+sh+h*.04);
  });
  ctx.strokeStyle=col+'44'; ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
  ctx.strokeRect(1,1,w-2,h-2);
}

function drawLineChart(ctx, w, h, widget, data) {
  clearCanvas(ctx, w, h);
  const col=widget.color;
  ctx.fillStyle=col; ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,4);
  ctx.font=`bold ${Math.round(h*.065)}px system-ui`;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,116,139,0.85)';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText(widget.title.toUpperCase(), w*.04, h*.13);

  // two stats
  ctx.font=`900 ${Math.round(h*.12)}px system-ui`;
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.fillText(data.uptime||'99.97%', w*.04, h*.26);
  ctx.font=`bold ${Math.round(h*.065)}px system-ui`;
  ctx.fillStyle=col;
  ctx.fillText(data.ltcy||'87ms avg latency', w*.36, h*.26);

  // line chart area
  const sx=w*.04, sy=h*.32, sw=w*.92, sh=h*.54;
  const pts=[99.6,99.7,99.8,99.7,99.85,99.9,99.95,99.97,99.97];
  const minV=99.5, maxV=100.0;

  // grid
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.04)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){
    const gy=sy+sh-(i/4)*sh;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(sx,gy);ctx.lineTo(sx+sw,gy);ctx.stroke();
  }

  // fill area
  ctx.fillStyle=col+'1a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  pts.forEach((v,i)=>{
    const nx=sx+i*(sw/(pts.length-1));
    const ny=sy+sh-((v-minV)/(maxV-minV))*sh;
    i===0?ctx.moveTo(nx,ny):ctx.lineTo(nx,ny);
  });
  ctx.lineTo(sx+sw,sy+sh); ctx.lineTo(sx,sy+sh);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  // line
  ctx.strokeStyle=col; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  pts.forEach((v,i)=>{
    const nx=sx+i*(sw/(pts.length-1));
    const ny=sy+sh-((v-minV)/(maxV-minV))*sh;
    i===0?ctx.moveTo(nx,ny):ctx.lineTo(nx,ny);
  });
  ctx.stroke();

  // end dot
  const lastX=sx+sw; const lastY=sy+sh-((pts[pts.length-1]-minV)/(maxV-minV))*sh;
  ctx.fillStyle=col;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(lastX,lastY,4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();

  ctx.strokeStyle=col+'44'; ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
  ctx.strokeRect(1,1,w-2,h-2);
}

function drawMapChart(ctx, w, h, widget, data) {
  clearCanvas(ctx, w, h);
  const col=widget.color;
  ctx.fillStyle=col; ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,4);
  ctx.font=`bold ${Math.round(h*.065)}px system-ui`;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,116,139,0.85)';
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText(widget.title.toUpperCase(), w*.04, h*.13);
  ctx.font=`900 ${Math.round(h*.12)}px system-ui`;
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.fillText('4 Regions', w*.04, h*.26);

  const regions=data.regions||PERIODS.Q4.regions;
  const sx=w*.04, sy=h*.30, barH=h*.1, gap=h*.04;
  const maxV=Math.max(...regions.map(r=>r.v));

  regions.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const bx=sx, by=sy+i*(barH+gap);
    const bw=(r.v/maxV)*(w*.56);
    // label
    ctx.font=`bold ${Math.round(h*.065)}px system-ui`;
    ctx.fillStyle=col;
    ctx.textAlign='left';
    ctx.fillText(r.r, bx, by+barH*.72);
    // track
    const tx=bx+w*.14;
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
    ctx.fillRect(tx, by, w*.56, barH);
    // fill
    const bg=ctx.createLinearGradient(tx,0,tx+bw,0);
    bg.addColorStop(0,col); bg.addColorStop(1,col+'44');
    ctx.fillStyle=bg;
    ctx.fillRect(tx, by, bw, barH);
    // value
    ctx.font=`bold ${Math.round(h*.065)}px system-ui`;
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
    ctx.textAlign='left';
    ctx.fillText(r.v+'%', tx+bw+6, by+barH*.72);
  });

  // emoji
  ctx.font=`${Math.round(h*.2)}px serif`;
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.globalAlpha=0.35;
  ctx.fillText(widget.emoji, w*.83, h*.55);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;

  ctx.strokeStyle=col+'44'; ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
  ctx.strokeRect(1,1,w-2,h-2);
}

// ─── CREATE WIDGET MESHES ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const widgetMeshes = [];
const hitboxes = [];
const widgetCanvases = {};

function createWidget(w) {
  const [wp, hp] = w.size;
  const texW = w.type==='kpi'?400:560;
  const texH = w.type==='kpi'?288:384;

  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width=texW; c.height=texH;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  widgetCanvases[w.id] = {canvas:c, ctx};

  // draw initial texture
  redrawWidget(w, ctx, texW, texH);

  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  tex.needsUpdate = true;
  widgetCanvases[w.id].tex = tex;

  const grp = new THREE.Group();
  grp.position.set(...w.pos);
  scene.add(grp);

  // body (thin box)
  const body = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.BoxGeometry(wp, hp, 0.08),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x0b1020, metalness:0.5, roughness:0.4})
  );
  grp.add(body);

  // display plane
  const display = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.PlaneGeometry(wp-0.06, hp-0.06),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:tex})
  );
  display.position.z = 0.045;
  grp.add(display);

  // edge glow
  const edges = new THREE.EdgesGeometry(new THREE.BoxGeometry(wp,hp,0.08));
  const edgeLine = new THREE.LineSegments(
    edges,
    new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:new THREE.Color(w.color), transparent:true, opacity:0.4})
  );
  grp.add(edgeLine);

  // glow behind
  const glowMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.PlaneGeometry(wp+0.5, hp+0.5),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:new THREE.Color(w.color), transparent:true, opacity:0.04, side:THREE.DoubleSide})
  );
  glowMesh.position.z = -0.1;
  grp.add(glowMesh);

  // invisible hitbox
  const hit = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.BoxGeometry(wp, hp, 0.2),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({visible:false})
  );
  hit.userData.wid = w.id;
  grp.add(hit);
  hitboxes.push(hit);

  // accent point light
  const pt = new THREE.PointLight(new THREE.Color(w.color), 0.5, 5);
  pt.position.set(0, 0, 0.8);
  grp.add(pt);
  widgetLights[w.id] = pt;

  widgetCanvases[w.id].grp = grp;
  widgetCanvases[w.id].edgeLine = edgeLine;
  widgetCanvases[w.id].edgeMat = edgeLine.material;
  widgetMeshes.push({grp, widget:w, baseY:w.pos[1]});
}

function redrawWidget(w, ctx, texW, texH) {
  const data = PERIODS[activePeriod];
  if(w.type==='kpi') drawKpiCard(ctx, texW, texH, w, w.getKpi(data));
  else if(w.type==='bar') drawBarChart(ctx, texW, texH, w, data);
  else if(w.type==='line') drawLineChart(ctx, texW, texH, w, data);
  else if(w.type==='map') drawMapChart(ctx, texW, texH, w, data);
}

function redrawAllWidgets() {
  WIDGETS.forEach(w => {
    const {ctx, canvas, tex} = widgetCanvases[w.id];
    redrawWidget(w, ctx, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    tex.needsUpdate = true;
  });
}

WIDGETS.forEach(createWidget);

// ─── RAYCASTER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const mouse2 = new THREE.Vector2();
let hoveredId = null;

canvas3d.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  const r=canvas3d.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse2.set(((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*2-1, -((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height)*2+1);
  raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse2, camera);
  const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(hitboxes);
  const newHover = hits.length ? hits[0].object.userData.wid : null;
  if(newHover !== hoveredId) {
    if(hoveredId) gsap.to(widgetCanvases[hoveredId].grp.scale, {x:1,y:1,z:1,duration:.2});
    if(newHover) gsap.to(widgetCanvases[newHover].grp.scale, {x:1.04,y:1.04,z:1.04,duration:.2});
    hoveredId = newHover;
    canvas3d.style.cursor = newHover ? 'pointer' : 'default';
  }
});

canvas3d.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const r=canvas3d.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse2.set(((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*2-1, -((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height)*2+1);
  raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse2, camera);
  const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(hitboxes);
  if(hits.length) {
    const w = WIDGETS.find(x=>x.id===hits[0].object.userData.wid);
    if(w) openWidget(w);
  }
});

// ─── CAMERA FLY-TO ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let flying=false;
function flyTo(cp, tgt, dur=1.6, cb) {
  if(flying) return;
  flying=true; controls.enabled=false;
  const sc=camera.position.clone(), st=controls.target.clone();
  const ec=new THREE.Vector3(...cp), et=new THREE.Vector3(...tgt);
  const proxy={t:0};
  gsap.to(proxy,{t:1,duration:dur,ease:'power3.inOut',
    onUpdate(){camera.position.lerpVectors(sc,ec,proxy.t);controls.target.lerpVectors(st,et,proxy.t);},
    onComplete(){flying=false;controls.enabled=true;if(cb)cb();}
  });
}
function flyHome(){flyTo([0,2,15],[0,0,0],1.5);}

// ─── PERIOD FILTER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
document.querySelectorAll('.period-btn').forEach(btn=>{
  btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    activePeriod=btn.dataset.p;
    document.querySelectorAll('.period-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    redrawAllWidgets();
    document.getElementById('v2d-period-lbl').textContent = activePeriod+' 2024';
    buildV2d();
    if(activeWidget) {
      populatePanel(activeWidget);
      drawTrendChart(activeWidget);
    }
    showNotif(`📊 Switched to ${activePeriod} 2024`);
  });
});

// ─── PANEL ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let activeWidget = null;
const panel = document.getElementById('panel');

function openWidget(w) {
  activeWidget = w;
  populatePanel(w);
  drawTrendChart(w);
  sidePanel.classList.add('open');

  // fly camera
  const [px,py,pz]=w.pos;
  flyTo([px+3, py+1.5, pz+7],[px,py,pz],1.5);

  // highlight edge
  WIDGETS.forEach(x=>{
    if(widgetCanvases[x.id]?.edgeMat)
      widgetCanvases[x.id].edgeMat.opacity = x.id===w.id ? 0.9 : 0.25;
  });
  widgetLights[w.id].intensity = 1.5;

  // video reset
  vidDur=w.dur; vidProg=0; vidPlaying=false;
  updateVidUI();
  buildChapters(w.chapters);

  showNotif(`${w.emoji} ${w.title} — Q${activePeriod} insight loaded`);
}

function populatePanel(w) {
  const data=PERIODS[activePeriod], kpi=w.getKpi(data);
  document.getElementById('p-badge').textContent=`${w.emoji} ${w.label}`;
  document.getElementById('p-badge').style.background=w.color+'22';
  document.getElementById('p-badge').style.color=w.color;
  document.getElementById('p-badge').style.border=`1px solid ${w.color}44`;
  document.getElementById('p-title').textContent=w.title;
  document.getElementById('p-period').textContent=`${activePeriod} 2024 · Updated now`;
  document.getElementById('kv-main').textContent=kpi.main;
  document.getElementById('kv-main').style.color=w.color;
  document.getElementById('kv-delta').textContent=kpi.delta;
  document.getElementById('kv-delta').className=`kpi-delta ${kpi.delta.startsWith('+')?'up':''}`;
  document.getElementById('kv-prev').textContent=kpi.prev;
  document.getElementById('kv-prev-d').textContent=kpi.prevD;
  document.getElementById('kv-prev-d').className='kpi-delta up';
  document.getElementById('kv-target').textContent=kpi.target;
  document.getElementById('kv-target-d').textContent=kpi.targetD;
  document.getElementById('kv-target-d').className='kpi-delta up';
  document.getElementById('insight-text').textContent=w.insight;
  document.getElementById('action-list').innerHTML=w.actions.map(a=>`<div class="action-item"><span class="action-ico">${a.slice(0,2)}</span><span class="action-txt">${a.slice(2)}</span></div>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('v-prog-fill').style.background=w.color;
}

function closePanel() {
  panel.classList.remove('open');
  activeWidget=null; stopVid();
  flyHome();
  WIDGETS.forEach(x=>{
    if(widgetCanvases[x.id]?.edgeMat)
      widgetCanvases[x.id].edgeMat.opacity=0.35;
    widgetLights[x.id].intensity=0.5;
  });
}
const sidePanel = panel;
document.getElementById('p-close').addEventListener('click', closePanel);

// ─── TREND CHART in panel ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function drawTrendChart(w) {
  const tc = document.getElementById('trend-canvas');
  const ctx = tc.getContext('2d');
  tc.width = tc.offsetWidth*2||760; tc.height=160;
  const width=tc.width, height=tc.height;
  const col=w.color, weekly=PERIODS[activePeriod].weekly;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);
  // grid
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.04)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){const y=height*(i/4);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(width,y);ctx.stroke();}
  // area
  const min=Math.min(...weekly), max=Math.max(...weekly);
  ctx.fillStyle=col+'2a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  weekly.forEach((v,i)=>{const nx=i*(width/(weekly.length-1));const ny=height-((v-min)/(max-min))*height*.85-height*.05;i===0?ctx.moveTo(nx,ny):ctx.lineTo(nx,ny);});
  ctx.lineTo(width,height); ctx.lineTo(0,height);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // line
  ctx.strokeStyle=col; ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  weekly.forEach((v,i)=>{const nx=i*(width/(weekly.length-1));const ny=height-((v-min)/(max-min))*height*.85-height*.05;i===0?ctx.moveTo(nx,ny):ctx.lineTo(nx,ny);});
  ctx.stroke();
  // dots
  weekly.forEach((v,i)=>{
    const nx=i*(width/(weekly.length-1));const ny=height-((v-min)/(max-min))*height*.85-height*.05;
    ctx.fillStyle=col; ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(nx,ny,3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    ctx.font='bold 20px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,116,139,0.9)';
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    const months=['Wk1','Wk2','Wk3','Wk4','Wk5','Wk6','Wk7','Wk8','Wk9'];
    ctx.fillText(months[i],nx,height-4);
  });
}

// ─── VIDEO PLAYER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const vidCanvas = document.getElementById('vid-canvas');
const vidCtx = vidCanvas.getContext('2d');
vidCanvas.width=640; vidCanvas.height=360;

let vidDur=120, vidProg=0, vidPlaying=false, vidRaf=null, vidLast=null;
let ccOn=true, curChap=0;

function fmtT(s){const m=Math.floor(s/60);return `${m}:${Math.floor(s%60).toString().padStart(2,'0')}`;}

function drawVidFrame() {
  if(!activeWidget)return;
  const w=activeWidget, col=w.color, ctx=vidCtx, cw=640, ch=360;
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,ch);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#06080e'); g.addColorStop(1,'#0c1020');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,cw,ch);
  // scan
  ctx.fillStyle=col+'18';
  ctx.fillRect(0,(vidProg*40)%ch,cw,3);
  // grid
  ctx.strokeStyle=col+'12'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let x=0;x<cw;x+=48){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x,ch);ctx.stroke();}
  for(let y=0;y<ch;y+=40){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(cw,y);ctx.stroke();}
  // emoji
  ctx.font='60px serif'; ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.globalAlpha=0.3; ctx.fillText(w.emoji,cw/2,ch/2+8); ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  // title
  ctx.font=`bold 20px system-ui`; ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.fillText(w.title,cw/2,ch/2-42);
  // progress ring
  const cx=cw/2, cy=ch/2+36, r=22;
  ctx.strokeStyle=col+'33'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle=col; ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,-Math.PI/2,-Math.PI/2+(vidProg/vidDur)*Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.font='bold 12px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle=col;
  ctx.fillText(Math.round((vidProg/vidDur)*100)+'%', cx, cy+4);
  // chapter label
  if(activeWidget.chapters[curChap]) {
    ctx.font=`bold 12px system-ui`; ctx.fillStyle=col;
    ctx.fillText('▶ '+activeWidget.chapters[curChap].t, cw/2, ch-28);
  }
  // progress bar
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.4)'; ctx.fillRect(0,ch-12,cw,12);
  ctx.fillStyle=col; ctx.fillRect(0,ch-12,(vidProg/vidDur)*cw,12);
  ctx.font='10px monospace'; ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillText(fmtT(vidProg),cw-8,ch-2);
}

function updateVidUI() {
  const pct=vidDur?(vidProg/vidDur)*100:0;
  document.getElementById('v-prog-fill').style.width=pct+'%';
  document.getElementById('v-time').textContent=`${fmtT(vidProg)} / ${fmtT(vidDur)}`;
  document.getElementById('v-play').textContent=vidPlaying?'⏸':'▶';
  if(activeWidget) {
    const c=activeWidget.chapters; let ci=0;
    for(let i=0;i<c.length;i++){if(vidProg>=c[i].s)ci=i;}
    curChap=ci;
    document.querySelectorAll('.chap-btn').forEach((el,idx)=>el.classList.toggle('active',idx===ci));
    if(ccOn&&activeWidget.subtitles){
      const si=Math.floor((vidProg/vidDur)*activeWidget.subtitles.length)%activeWidget.subtitles.length;
      document.getElementById('sub-bar').textContent=activeWidget.subtitles[si];
    } else document.getElementById('sub-bar').textContent='';
  }
  drawVidFrame();
}

function playVid(){
  if(!vidPlaying){if(vidProg>=vidDur)vidProg=0;vidPlaying=true;vidLast=performance.now();
    const tick=(now)=>{if(!vidPlaying)return;const dt=(now-vidLast)/1000;vidLast=now;vidProg=Math.min(vidProg+dt,vidDur);if(vidProg>=vidDur)vidPlaying=false;updateVidUI();vidRaf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);};
    vidRaf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
}
function pauseVid(){vidPlaying=false;}
function stopVid(){vidPlaying=false;vidProg=0;if(vidRaf)cancelAnimationFrame(vidRaf);}
function prevChap(){if(!activeWidget)return;const c=activeWidget.chapters;vidProg=c[Math.max(0,curChap-1)].s;updateVidUI();}
function nextChap(){if(!activeWidget)return;const c=activeWidget.chapters;vidProg=c[Math.min(curChap+1,c.length-1)].s;updateVidUI();}
function buildChapters(chaps) {
  const el=document.getElementById('chap-wrap');
  el.innerHTML=chaps.map((c,i)=>`<button class="chap-btn" data-i="${i}">${c.t}</button>`).join('');
  el.querySelectorAll('.chap-btn').forEach(b=>{b.addEventListener('click',()=>{vidProg=chaps[+b.dataset.i].s;updateVidUI();});});
}
document.getElementById('v-play').addEventListener('click',()=>{vidPlaying?pauseVid():playVid();updateVidUI();});
document.getElementById('v-prev').addEventListener('click',prevChap);
document.getElementById('v-next').addEventListener('click',nextChap);
document.getElementById('v-cc').addEventListener('click',()=>{ccOn=!ccOn;document.getElementById('v-cc').classList.toggle('on',ccOn);updateVidUI();});
const vTrack=document.getElementById('v-prog-track');
let vScrub=false;
function vScrubAt(cx){const r=vTrack.getBoundingClientRect();vidProg=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(cx-r.left)/r.width))*vidDur;updateVidUI();}
vTrack.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{vScrub=true;vScrubAt(e.clientX);});
window.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{if(vScrub)vScrubAt(e.clientX);});
window.addEventListener('mouseup',()=>{vScrub=false;});

// ─── COMPARE MODE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const cmpOverlay = document.getElementById('compare-overlay');
const cmpLeftCanvas = document.getElementById('cmp-left-canvas');
const cmpRightCanvas = document.getElementById('cmp-right-canvas');
const cmpLCtx = cmpLeftCanvas.getContext('2d');
const cmpRCtx = cmpRightCanvas.getContext('2d');
let cmpProg=0, cmpPlaying=false, cmpRaf=null, cmpLast=null;
const CMP_DUR=150;

function initCmpCanvases() {
  cmpLeftCanvas.width=600; cmpLeftCanvas.height=cmpLeftCanvas.offsetHeight*2||400;
  cmpRightCanvas.width=600; cmpRightCanvas.height=cmpRightCanvas.offsetHeight*2||400;
}

function drawCmpFrame(ctx, period, prog, w, cw, ch) {
  const data=PERIODS[period];
  const col = period==='Q3'?'#f59e0b':'#34d399';
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,ch);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#06080e'); g.addColorStop(1,'#0b1020');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,cw,ch);
  // scan
  ctx.fillStyle=col+'15'; ctx.fillRect(0,(prog*40)%ch,cw,2);
  // grid
  ctx.strokeStyle=col+'10'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let x=0;x<cw;x+=48){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x,ch);ctx.stroke();}
  // widget emoji/title
  if(w){
    ctx.font='52px serif'; ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.globalAlpha=0.3;
    ctx.fillText(w.emoji,cw/2,ch/2-30); ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    ctx.font='bold 18px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
    ctx.fillText(w.title,cw/2,ch/2+20);
    // period label
    ctx.font='bold 28px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle=col;
    ctx.fillText(period+' 2024', cw/2, ch/2+55);
  }
  // bar chart comparing weekly data
  const weekly=data.weekly||[];
  const sx=cw*.04, sy=ch*.62, sw=cw*.92, bh=ch*.25;
  const maxV=Math.max(...weekly)+.2;
  weekly.forEach((v,i)=>{
    const bw=sw/weekly.length*.7;
    const bx=sx+i*(sw/weekly.length);
    const fh=(v/maxV)*bh*Math.min(1,prog/50+.3); // animate in based on progress
    ctx.fillStyle=col+'33'; ctx.fillRect(bx,sy,bw,bh);
    const bg2=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,sy+bh-fh,0,sy+bh);
    bg2.addColorStop(0,col); bg2.addColorStop(1,col+'44');
    ctx.fillStyle=bg2; ctx.fillRect(bx,sy+bh-fh,bw,fh);
  });
  // progress indicator
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.4)'; ctx.fillRect(0,ch-8,cw,8);
  ctx.fillStyle=col; ctx.fillRect(0,ch-8,(prog/CMP_DUR)*cw,8);
  ctx.font='9px monospace'; ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillText(fmtT(prog)+' / '+fmtT(CMP_DUR), cw-6, ch-1);
}

function drawCmpBoth() {
  const cw=cmpLeftCanvas.width, ch=cmpLeftCanvas.height;
  drawCmpFrame(cmpLCtx,'Q3',cmpProg,activeWidget,cw,ch);
  const cw2=cmpRightCanvas.width, ch2=cmpRightCanvas.height;
  drawCmpFrame(cmpRCtx,'Q4',cmpProg,activeWidget,cw2,ch2);
  // update progress bar
  document.getElementById('cmp-prog-fill').style.width=((cmpProg/CMP_DUR)*100)+'%';
  document.getElementById('cmp-time-lbl').textContent=`${fmtT(cmpProg)} / ${fmtT(CMP_DUR)}`;
  // subtitles
  if(activeWidget?.subtitles) {
    const si=Math.floor((cmpProg/CMP_DUR)*activeWidget.subtitles.length)%activeWidget.subtitles.length;
    const q3sub=['Q3: '+activeWidget.subtitles[si].replace('4.2M','3.56M').replace('284K','231K').replace('7.4%','5.3%')];
    document.getElementById('cmp-sub-left').textContent=q3sub[0];
    document.getElementById('cmp-sub-right').textContent=activeWidget.subtitles[si];
  }
}

function populateCmpKpis(w) {
  const q3=PERIODS.Q3, q4=PERIODS.Q4;
  function kpiHtml(label, q3v, q4v) {
    return `<div class="cmp-kpi"><div class="cmp-kpi-val" style="color:#f59e0b">${q3v}</div><div class="cmp-kpi-lbl">${label}</div></div>`;
  }
  function kpiHtml2(label, val, delta, col) {
    return `<div class="cmp-kpi"><div class="cmp-kpi-val" style="color:${col}">${val}</div><div class="cmp-kpi-lbl">${label}</div><div class="cmp-kpi-d" style="color:${col}">${delta}</div></div>`;
  }
  const kq3=w.getKpi(q3), kq4=w.getKpi(q4);
  document.getElementById('cmp-kpis-q3').innerHTML=
    kpiHtml2('Primary',kq3.main,kq3.delta,'#f59e0b')+
    kpiHtml2('vs Prior',kq3.prev,kq3.prevD,'#64748b')+
    kpiHtml2('Target',kq3.target,kq3.targetD,'#64748b');
  document.getElementById('cmp-kpis-q4').innerHTML=
    kpiHtml2('Primary',kq4.main,kq4.delta,'#34d399')+
    kpiHtml2('vs Q3',kq3.main,'▲ Prev','#64748b')+
    kpiHtml2('Target',kq4.target,kq4.targetD,'#34d399');
}

function playCmp(){
  if(!cmpPlaying){if(cmpProg>=CMP_DUR)cmpProg=0;cmpPlaying=true;cmpLast=performance.now();
    const tick=(now)=>{if(!cmpPlaying)return;const dt=(now-cmpLast)/1000;cmpLast=now;cmpProg=Math.min(cmpProg+dt,CMP_DUR);if(cmpProg>=CMP_DUR)cmpPlaying=false;drawCmpBoth();cmpRaf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);};
    cmpRaf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
}
function pauseCmp(){cmpPlaying=false;}

document.getElementById('cmp-play').addEventListener('click',()=>{playCmp();document.getElementById('cmp-play').classList.add('active');document.getElementById('cmp-pause').classList.remove('active');});
document.getElementById('cmp-pause').addEventListener('click',()=>{pauseCmp();document.getElementById('cmp-pause').classList.add('active');document.getElementById('cmp-play').classList.remove('active');});

const cmpTrack=document.getElementById('cmp-prog-track');
let cmpScrub=false;
function cmpScrubAt(cx){const r=cmpTrack.getBoundingClientRect();cmpProg=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(cx-r.left)/r.width))*CMP_DUR;drawCmpBoth();}
cmpTrack.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{cmpScrub=true;cmpScrubAt(e.clientX);});
window.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{if(cmpScrub)cmpScrubAt(e.clientX);});
window.addEventListener('mouseup',()=>{cmpScrub=false;});

document.getElementById('btn-compare').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(!activeWidget) return;
  cmpOverlay.classList.add('show');
  document.getElementById('cmp-widget-title').textContent=`${activeWidget.title} — Period Comparison`;
  populateCmpKpis(activeWidget);
  cmpProg=0;
  setTimeout(()=>{
    initCmpCanvases();
    drawCmpBoth();
    playCmp();
  },50);
});
document.getElementById('cmp-close').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  cmpOverlay.classList.remove('show');
  pauseCmp();
});

// ─── 2D FALLBACK ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function buildV2d() {
  const data=PERIODS[activePeriod];
  const grid=document.getElementById('v2d-grid');
  grid.innerHTML=WIDGETS.map(w=>{
    const kpi=w.getKpi(data);
    return `<div class="v2d-card" style="border-color:${w.color}44" onclick="">
      <style>.v2d-card[data-id="${w.id}"]::before{background:${w.color}}</style>
      <div class="v2d-lbl">${w.emoji} ${w.label}</div>
      <div class="v2d-kpi" style="color:${w.color}">${kpi.main}</div>
      <div style="font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.4rem">${w.title}</div>
      <div class="v2d-delta" style="color:${w.color}">${kpi.delta}</div>
      <div style="font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:.3rem">${activePeriod} 2024 · ${w.getKpi(data).prev} prev</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}
buildV2d();

let is2d=false;
document.getElementById('btn-2d').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  is2d=!is2d;
  document.getElementById('view2d').style.display=is2d?'block':'none';
  document.getElementById('btn-2d').textContent=is2d?'3D View':'2D View';
  document.getElementById('btn-2d').classList.toggle('active',is2d);
});
document.getElementById('btn-home').addEventListener('click',()=>{closePanel();showNotif('🔭 Camera reset');});

// ─── NODE LABELS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const labelsEl=document.getElementById('labels');
const labelMap={};
WIDGETS.forEach(w=>{
  const el=document.createElement('div');
  el.className='wlbl';
  el.textContent=w.title;
  labelsEl.appendChild(el);
  labelMap[w.id]=el;
});
const _v=new THREE.Vector3();
function updateLabels(){
  WIDGETS.forEach(w=>{
    _v.set(...w.pos).project(camera);
    const x=(_v.x*.5+.5)*canvas3d.clientWidth;
    const y=(-_v.y*.5+.5)*canvas3d.clientHeight+52;
    const el=labelMap[w.id];
    if(_v.z<1){el.style.display='block';el.style.left=x+'px';el.style.top=(y+w.size[1]/2*42+10)+'px';}
    else el.style.display='none';
  });
}

// ─── NOTIFICATIONS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function showNotif(msg){
  const el=document.createElement('div');
  el.className='notif'; el.textContent=msg;
  document.getElementById('notifs').appendChild(el);
  gsap.to(el,{opacity:1,y:0,duration:.3,ease:'back.out(1.4)'});
  setTimeout(()=>{gsap.to(el,{opacity:0,y:6,duration:.25,onComplete:()=>el.remove()});},2800);
}

// ─── RESIZE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function resize(){
  const w=window.innerWidth,h=window.innerHeight;
  renderer.setSize(w,h);
  camera.aspect=w/h; camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
resize(); window.addEventListener('resize',resize);

// ─── RENDER LOOP ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const clock=new THREE.Clock();
function animate(){
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const t=clock.getElapsedTime();
  controls.update();
  // float widgets
  widgetMeshes.forEach(({grp,widget,baseY},i)=>{
    grp.position.y=baseY+Math.sin(t*0.7+i*0.8)*0.07;
    grp.rotation.y=Math.sin(t*0.25+i*0.5)*0.025;
  });
  updateLabels();
  renderer.render(scene,camera);
}
animate();

// ─── KEYBOARD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.key==='Escape'){closePanel();cmpOverlay.classList.remove('show');pauseCmp();}
  if(e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();vidPlaying?pauseVid():playVid();updateVidUI();}
  if(e.key==='ArrowRight')nextChap();
  if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')prevChap();
});

setTimeout(()=>showNotif('📊 Click any widget to open its video insight'),700);
</script>
</body>
</html>

function makeSpot(x,y,z,col,intensity,angle=Math.PI/7) {
  const s=new THREE.SpotLight(col,intensity,18,angle,0.45);
  s.position.set(x,y,z); s.castShadow=true;
  s.shadow.mapSize.set(512,512);
  scene.add(s); scene.add(s.target);
  s.target.position.set(x,0,z);
  // ceiling disk
  const disk=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.18,24),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:col}));
  disk.rotation.x=Math.PI/2; disk.position.set(x,y-.01,z);
  scene.add(disk);
  return s;
}

// ─── MARBLE FLOOR TEXTURE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function makeMarble() {
  const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=1024; c.height=1024;
  const ctx=c.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle='#12141e'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,1024,1024);
  // veining
  for(let i=0;i<24;i++) {
    const alpha=0.05+Math.random()*.18;
    ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${140+Math.random()*60},${150+Math.random()*60},${180+Math.random()*60},${alpha})`;
    ctx.lineWidth=0.4+Math.random()*2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    let px=Math.random()*1024, py=0;
    ctx.moveTo(px,py);
    for(let j=0;j<6;j++) {
      const cx1=Math.random()*1024,cy1=j*170+Math.random()*60;
      const cx2=Math.random()*1024,cy2=(j+1)*160;
      px+=(-200+Math.random()*400); py=(j+1)*170;
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx1,cy1,cx2,cy2,Math.max(0,Math.min(1024,px)),Math.max(0,Math.min(1024,py)));
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
}

marbleTex.wrapS=marbleTex.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;
marbleTex.repeat.set(4,4);

// Welcome screen draw function
let welcomeT=0, welcomePlaying=true;
function drawWelcomeScreen(t) {
  const ctx=scrCtx,w=1024,h=576;
  // bg
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,h);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#05060c'); g.addColorStop(1,'#0a0b14');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
  // subtle scan line
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(201,168,76,0.04)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,(t*20)%h,w,2);
  // gold accent lines
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(201,168,76,0.12)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(100,h-90); ctx.lineTo(w-100,h-90); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(100,90); ctx.lineTo(w-100,90); ctx.stroke();
  // company name
  const pulse=0.92+Math.sin(t*.8)*.08;
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(w/2,h/2-28); ctx.scale(pulse,pulse);
  ctx.font='italic 90px Georgia,serif'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(201,168,76,0.95)';
  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText('NEXUS', 0, 0); ctx.restore();
  // tagline
  ctx.font='300 20px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(232,228,220,0.55)';
  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='top';
  ctx.fillText('W  E  L  C  O  M  E', w/2, h/2+52);
  // gold rule
  const ruleW=180*(0.6+Math.sin(t*.6)*.4);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(201,168,76,0.55)';
  ctx.fillRect(w/2-ruleW/2, h/2+42, ruleW, 1);
  // subtitle
  const sub=getSub(WELCOME_SUBS,(welcomeT%30));
  if(sub) {
    ctx.font='18px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(232,228,220,0.85)';
    ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='bottom';
    ctx.fillRect(w/2-260,h-48,520,28);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
    ctx.fillRect(w/2-260,h-48,520,28);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(232,228,220,0.85)';
    ctx.fillText(sub,w/2,h-22);
  }
  // progress bar
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.05)'; ctx.fillRect(80,h-14,w-160,4);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(201,168,76,0.6)';
  ctx.fillRect(80,h-14,(w-160)*((welcomeT%30)/30),4);
  scrTex.needsUpdate=true;
}

// ─── HOTSPOT MARKERS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const hotspotObjects=[];
const hitboxes=[];

function makeHotspotMarker(h) {
  const grp=new THREE.Group();
  grp.position.set(...h.pos);
  scene.add(grp);
  const col=new THREE.Color(h.color);

  // Outer ring
  const r1=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(.28,.32,40),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:col,transparent:true,opacity:.5,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));
  r1.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2; grp.add(r1);

  // Inner ring
  const r2=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(.14,.17,40),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:col,transparent:true,opacity:.7,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));
  r2.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2; grp.add(r2);

  // Center gem
  const gem=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.09,16,16),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:col,emissive:col,emissiveIntensity:.7,metalness:.5,roughness:.2}));
  gem.position.y=.12; grp.add(gem);

  // Vertical beam
  const beam=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.008,.008,h.pos[1]-.1,8),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:col,transparent:true,opacity:.3}));
  beam.position.y=-h.pos[1]/2; grp.add(beam);

  // Glow light
  const pt=new THREE.PointLight(col,.8,3.5);
  pt.position.y=.2; grp.add(pt);

  // Hitbox
  const hit=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.4,8,8),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({visible:false}));
  hit.userData.hid=h.id;
  grp.add(hit); hitboxes.push(hit);

  hotspotObjects.push({grp,r1,r2,gem,pt,data:h,r1mat:r1.material,r2mat:r2.material});
}
HOTSPOTS.forEach(makeHotspotMarker);

  const el=document.createElement('div');
