const _v=new THREE.Vector3();
function updateLabels(){
  HOTSPOTS.forEach(h=>{
    _v.set(...h.pos).project(camera);
    const x=(_v.x*.5+.5)*canvas.clientWidth;
    const y=(-_v.y*.5+.5)*canvas.clientHeight;
    const el=labelEls[h.id];
    if(_v.z<1){
      el.style.left=x+'px'; el.style.top=(y+56)+'px';
      el.style.display='block';
    } else el.style.display='none';
  });
}

// ─── RAYCASTING ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const ray=new THREE.Raycaster();
const mouse=new THREE.Vector2();

canvas.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
  if(!controls.enabled) return;
  const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.set(((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*2-1,-((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height)*2+1);
  ray.setFromCamera(mouse,camera);
  const hits=ray.intersectObjects(hitboxes);
  canvas.style.cursor=hits.length?'pointer':'default';
});

canvas.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  if(!controls.enabled) return;
  const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.set(((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*2-1,-((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height)*2+1);
  ray.setFromCamera(mouse,camera);
  const hits=ray.intersectObjects(hitboxes);
  if(hits.length){
    const h=HOTSPOTS.find(x=>x.id===hits[0].object.userData.hid);
    if(h) openHotspot(h);
  }
});

// ─── CAMERA FLY-TO ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let flying=false;
function flyTo(cp,tgt,dur=1.8,cb){
  if(flying)return;
  flying=true; controls.enabled=false;
  const sc=camera.position.clone(), st=controls.target.clone();
  const ec=new THREE.Vector3(...cp), et=new THREE.Vector3(...tgt);
  const proxy={t:0};
  gsap.to(proxy,{t:1,duration:dur,ease:'power3.inOut',
    onUpdate(){camera.position.lerpVectors(sc,ec,proxy.t);controls.target.lerpVectors(st,et,proxy.t);},
    onComplete(){flying=false;controls.enabled=true;if(cb)cb();}
  });
}
function flyHome(){flyTo([0,3.5,8],[0,2,-4],1.5);}

  veil.classList.add('gone');
  // dolly-in

  gsap.to(proxy,{cz:8,cy:3.5,tz:-5,ty:2,duration:4.2,ease:'power2.inOut',
    onUpdate(){
      camera.position.set(0,proxy.cy,proxy.cz);

      },600);

  });
},300);

// ─── MODAL / VIDEO PLAYER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const modal=document.getElementById('modal');
const vidCanvas=document.getElementById('vid-canvas');
const vidCtx=vidCanvas.getContext('2d');
vidCanvas.width=640; vidCanvas.height=360;

let vidDur=25, vidProg=0, vidPlaying=false, vidRaf=null, vidLast=null;
let ccOn=true, curChap=0, activeHotspot=null;

function getSub(subs, t) {
  return subs.find(s=>t>=s.s&&t<s.e)?.t||'';
}

function fmtT(s){return `${Math.floor(s/60)}:${Math.floor(s%60).toString().padStart(2,'0')}`;}

function drawVidFrame(t) {
  if(!activeHotspot)return;
  const h=activeHotspot, ctx=vidCtx, cw=640, ch=360, col=h.color;
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,ch);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#05060c'); g.addColorStop(1,'#0a0b16');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,cw,ch);
  // subtle grid
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(201,168,76,0.05)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let x=0;x<cw;x+=64){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x,ch);ctx.stroke();}
  // scan
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(201,168,76,0.06)'; ctx.fillRect(0,(t*30)%ch,cw,2);
  // title
  ctx.font='italic 28px Georgia,serif'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(201,168,76,.95)';
  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='top';
  ctx.fillText(h.title, cw/2, ch*.18);
  // category
  ctx.font='600 11px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(201,168,76,0.55)';
  ctx.fillText(h.cat.toUpperCase(), cw/2, ch*.12);
  // divider
  const dw=140*(0.5+Math.sin(t*.7)*.5);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(201,168,76,0.4)'; ctx.fillRect(cw/2-dw/2,ch*.35,dw,1);
  // chapter label
  if(h.chapters[curChap]) {
    ctx.font='bold 13px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(201,168,76,0.7)';
    ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillText('▶  '+h.chapters[curChap].t, cw/2, ch*.55);
  }
  // progress arc
  const cx=cw/2, cy=ch*.72, r=28;
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(201,168,76,0.15)'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle=col; ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,-Math.PI/2,-Math.PI/2+(vidProg/vidDur)*Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.font='bold 11px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(201,168,76,.9)'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText(Math.round((vidProg/vidDur)*100)+'%',cx,cy);
  // progress bar
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.05)'; ctx.fillRect(60,ch-14,cw-120,4);
  ctx.fillStyle=col; ctx.fillRect(60,ch-14,(cw-120)*(vidProg/vidDur),4);
  ctx.font='10px monospace'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.5)'; ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillText(fmtT(vidProg),cw-60,ch-4);
}

function updateVidUI(){
  const pct=vidDur?(vidProg/vidDur)*100:0;
  document.getElementById('prog-fill').style.width=pct+'%';
  document.getElementById('v-time').textContent=`${fmtT(vidProg)} / ${fmtT(vidDur)}`;
  document.getElementById('v-play').textContent=vidPlaying?'⏸':'▶';
  if(activeHotspot){
    const c=activeHotspot.chapters; let ci=0;
    for(let i=0;i<c.length;i++){if(vidProg>=c[i].s)ci=i;}
    curChap=ci;
    document.querySelectorAll('.chap-btn').forEach((el,i)=>el.classList.toggle('active',i===ci));
    document.getElementById('sub-text').textContent=
      ccOn?getSub(activeHotspot.subs,vidProg):'';
  }
}

function playVid(){
  if(!vidPlaying){
    if(vidProg>=vidDur)vidProg=0;
    vidPlaying=true; vidLast=performance.now();
    const tick=now=>{
      if(!vidPlaying)return;
      const dt=(now-vidLast)/1000; vidLast=now;
      vidProg=Math.min(vidProg+dt,vidDur);
      if(vidProg>=vidDur)vidPlaying=false;
      updateVidUI(); vidRaf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    vidRaf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
}
function pauseVid(){vidPlaying=false;}
function stopVid(){vidPlaying=false;vidProg=0;if(vidRaf)cancelAnimationFrame(vidRaf);}
function prevChap(){if(!activeHotspot)return;vidProg=activeHotspot.chapters[Math.max(0,curChap-1)].s;updateVidUI();}
function nextChap(){if(!activeHotspot)return;vidProg=activeHotspot.chapters[Math.min(curChap+1,activeHotspot.chapters.length-1)].s;updateVidUI();}

function openHotspot(h) {
  activeHotspot=h;
  document.getElementById('modal-cat').textContent=h.cat;
  document.getElementById('modal-title').textContent=h.title;
  document.getElementById('modal-desc').textContent=h.desc;
  document.getElementById('modal-stats').innerHTML=h.stats.map(s=>`<div class="stat-pill">${s}</div>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('chap-row').innerHTML=h.chapters.map((c,i)=>`<button class="chap-btn" data-i="${i}">${c.t}</button>`).join('');
  document.querySelectorAll('.chap-btn').forEach(b=>{
    b.addEventListener('click',()=>{vidProg=h.chapters[+b.dataset.i].s;updateVidUI();});
  });
  vidDur=h.dur; vidProg=0; vidPlaying=false;
  updateVidUI();
  modal.classList.add('open');
  // fly near hotspot
  const [hx,hy,hz]=h.pos;
  flyTo([hx+2,hy+1.5,hz+5],[hx,hy,hz],1.6,()=>playVid());
}

function closeModal(){
  modal.classList.remove('open');
  stopVid(); activeHotspot=null;
  flyHome();
}

document.getElementById('modal-close').addEventListener('click',closeModal);
document.getElementById('v-play').addEventListener('click',()=>{vidPlaying?pauseVid():playVid();updateVidUI();});
document.getElementById('v-prev').addEventListener('click',prevChap);
document.getElementById('v-next').addEventListener('click',nextChap);
document.getElementById('v-cc').addEventListener('click',()=>{ccOn=!ccOn;document.getElementById('v-cc').classList.toggle('on',ccOn);updateVidUI();});

const progTrack=document.getElementById('prog-track');
let scrubbing=false;
function scrubAt(cx){const r=progTrack.getBoundingClientRect();vidProg=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(cx-r.left)/r.width))*vidDur;updateVidUI();}
progTrack.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{scrubbing=true;scrubAt(e.clientX);});
window.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{if(scrubbing)scrubAt(e.clientX);});
window.addEventListener('mouseup',()=>{scrubbing=false;});

// ─── GUIDED TOUR ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let tourIdx=0, tourActive=false;
const TOUR=[
  {cam:[0,4,12],tgt:[0,2.8,-11.8],after:null},
  ...HOTSPOTS.map(h=>({cam:[h.pos[0]+3,h.pos[1]+2,h.pos[2]+5],tgt:h.pos,after:h})),
];
document.getElementById('btn-tour').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(!introComplete)return;
  tourActive=true; tourIdx=0; runTourStep();
});
function runTourStep(){
  if(tourIdx>=TOUR.length){tourActive=false;flyHome();return;}
  const step=TOUR[tourIdx];
  flyTo(step.cam,step.tgt,1.8,()=>{
    if(step.after){openHotspot(step.after);}
    else{
      setTimeout(()=>{if(tourActive){tourIdx++;runTourStep();}},3000);
    }
  });
}
// Auto-advance tour after modal close if tour active
const origClose=closeModal;
document.getElementById('modal-close').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(tourActive){setTimeout(()=>{tourIdx++;runTourStep();},800);}
});

// ─── 2D FALLBACK ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const v2dGrid=document.getElementById('v2d-grid');
v2dGrid.innerHTML=HOTSPOTS.map(h=>`
  <div class="v2d-card">
    <div class="v2d-card-cat">${h.cat}</div>
    <div class="v2d-card-title">${h.title}</div>
    <div class="v2d-card-desc">${h.desc}</div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:.75rem">
      ${h.stats.map(s=>`<div style="font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--gold);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.25);padding:2px 8px;font-family:var(--sans)">${s}</div>`).join('')}
    </div>
  </div>`).join('');

// 2D welcome video
const v2dCanvas=document.getElementById('v2d-vid-canvas');
const v2dCtx=v2dCanvas.getContext('2d');
v2dCanvas.width=800; v2dCanvas.height=450;
let v2dProg=0, v2dPlaying=false, v2dRaf=null, v2dLast=null;
function drawV2dWelcome(t){
  drawWelcomeScreenOnCtx(v2dCtx,800,450,t);
  document.getElementById('v2d-fill').style.width=((v2dProg/30)*100)+'%';
  document.getElementById('v2d-time').textContent=`${fmtT(v2dProg)} / 0:30`;
}
function drawWelcomeScreenOnCtx(ctx,w,h,t){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,h);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#05060c'); g.addColorStop(1,'#0a0b14');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(201,168,76,0.04)'; ctx.fillRect(0,(t*20)%h,w,2);
  const p=0.92+Math.sin(t*.8)*.08;
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(w/2,h/2-20); ctx.scale(p,p);
  ctx.font=`italic ${Math.round(h*.18)}px Georgia,serif`; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(201,168,76,0.95)';
  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText('NEXUS',0,0); ctx.restore();
  ctx.font=`300 ${Math.round(h*.04)}px system-ui`; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(232,228,220,0.45)';
  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='top';
  ctx.fillText('W  E  L  C  O  M  E', w/2, h/2+38);
}
document.getElementById('v2d-play').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(!v2dPlaying){
    if(v2dProg>=30)v2dProg=0;
    v2dPlaying=true; v2dLast=performance.now();
    document.getElementById('v2d-play').textContent='⏸';
    const tick=now=>{if(!v2dPlaying)return;const dt=(now-v2dLast)/1000;v2dLast=now;v2dProg=Math.min(v2dProg+dt,30);if(v2dProg>=30)v2dPlaying=false;v2dRaf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);};
    v2dRaf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  } else {v2dPlaying=false;document.getElementById('v2d-play').textContent='▶';}
});
drawV2dWelcome(0);

let is2d=false;
document.getElementById('btn-2d').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  is2d=!is2d;
  document.getElementById('view2d').style.display=is2d?'block':'none';
  document.getElementById('btn-2d').textContent=is2d?'3D Lobby':'2D View';
});

// ─── RESIZE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function resize(){
  const w=window.innerWidth,h=window.innerHeight;
  renderer.setSize(w,h); camera.aspect=w/h; camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
resize(); window.addEventListener('resize',resize);

// ─── RENDER LOOP ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const clock=new THREE.Clock();
let v2dT=0;
function animate(){
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const t=clock.getElapsedTime();

  // Welcome screen
  if(welcomePlaying){ welcomeT+=clock.getDelta?0:1/60; }
  welcomeT=t; // use elapsed for consistency
  drawWelcomeScreen(t);

  // Video frame (in modal)
  if(modal.classList.contains('open')&&activeHotspot){
    drawVidFrame(t);
  }

  // 2D video
  if(v2dPlaying){ v2dT+=1/60; drawV2dWelcome(v2dT); }

  // Hotspot animations
  hotspotObjects.forEach((obj,i)=>{
    const st=t*1.8+i*1.3;
    obj.gem.position.y=.12+Math.sin(st)*.06;
    obj.r1mat.opacity=.35+Math.sin(st*1.2)*.2;
    obj.r2mat.opacity=.2+Math.sin(st*.8+1)*.15;
    obj.r1.scale.setScalar(1+Math.sin(st*.9)*.07);
    obj.r2.scale.setScalar(1+Math.sin(st*.7+.5)*.12);
    obj.pt.intensity=.6+Math.sin(st*1.4)*.3;
  });

  // Screen glow pulse
  screenPt.intensity=.7+Math.sin(t*1.2)*.2;

  updateLabels();
  controls.update();
  renderer.render(scene,camera);
}
animate();

// ─── KEYBOARD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.key==='Escape')closeModal();
  if(e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();vidPlaying?pauseVid():playVid();updateVidUI();}
  if(e.key==='ArrowRight')nextChap();
  if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')prevChap();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
<title>PRISM — Product Gallery 3D</title>
<script type="importmap">{"imports":{"three":"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.158.0/build/three.module.js","three/addons/":"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.158.0/examples/jsm/"}}</script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/gsap.min.js"></script>
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --bg:#06070d;--dark:#0a0b14;--border:#1a1e2e;--text:#e8e4dc;--muted:#64748b;
  --gold:#c9a84c;--font:'Georgia',serif;--sans:system-ui,sans-serif
}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--sans)}
canvas{display:block;position:fixed;inset:0}

/* NAV */
#nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:52px;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 1.5rem;z-index:50;background:rgba(6,7,13,.88);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.nav-brand{font-family:var(--font);font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:.25em;color:var(--text);margin-right:auto}
.nav-brand span{color:var(--gold)}
.nav-tag{font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-right:auto;padding-left:1rem}
.nbtn{padding:5px 14px;border-radius:2px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);transition:all .15s}
.nbtn:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.nbtn.active{background:var(--gold);color:#000;border-color:var(--gold)}

/* DRAG HINT */
#hint{position:fixed;bottom:1.4rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);z-index:20;transition:opacity .6s;pointer-events:none}
#hint.gone{opacity:0}

/* HOVER TOOLTIP */
#tooltip{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;z-index:25;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;transform:translate(-50%,-100%)}
.tip-inner{background:rgba(10,11,20,.95);border:1px solid var(--gold);padding:.5rem 1rem;text-align:center}
.tip-name{font-family:var(--font);font-size:.88rem;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:2px}
.tip-sub{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold)}

/* OVERLAY */
#overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:80;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .35s;background:rgba(4,5,10,.93);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
#overlay.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:all}
#ov-box{width:min(1040px,96vw);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 380px;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.18);background:var(--dark)}
@media(max-width:700px){#ov-box{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.ov-left{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.ov-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:.7rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.ov-cat{font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold)}
.ov-title{font-family:var(--font);font-size:1rem;color:var(--text);margin-top:2px}
.ov-close{background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:var(--muted);width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;font-size:.75rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:all .15s;flex-shrink:0;font-family:var(--sans)}
.ov-close:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
#vid-canvas{width:100%;display:block;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:#000}
.sub-bar{min-height:32px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:5px 1rem;background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
#sub-text{font-size:.76rem;color:#f0ede4;text-align:center;font-family:var(--sans)}
.vid-ctrls{padding:.6rem 1rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.prog-track{width:100%;height:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:1px;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:.55rem;position:relative}
.prog-fill{height:100%;border-radius:1px;pointer-events:none}
.ctrl-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem}
.ctrl-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;font-size:.82rem;padding:3px;transition:color .12s}
.ctrl-btn:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.vid-time{font-size:.6rem;color:var(--muted);margin-left:auto;letter-spacing:.06em}
.cc-btn{padding:2px 6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border-radius:1px;transition:all .12s}
.cc-btn.on{background:var(--gold);color:#000;border-color:var(--gold)}
.chap-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;padding:.55rem 1rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.chap-btn{padding:2px 9px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;border-radius:1px;transition:all .12s}
.chap-btn.active,.chap-btn:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}

/* RIGHT SPECS PANEL */
.ov-right{border-left:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
.spec-hero{padding:1.2rem 1rem .8rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.spec-price{font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.5px;margin-bottom:3px}
.spec-tagline{font-family:var(--font);font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);font-style:italic}
.spec-list{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:.75rem 1rem}
.spec-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:.6rem;padding:.6rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.spec-item:last-child{border:none}
.spec-gem{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:.35rem}
.spec-txt{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text);line-height:1.5}
.spec-foot{padding:.85rem 1rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;gap:.5rem}
.btn-primary{flex:1;padding:9px;border:none;background:var(--gold);color:#000;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .15s}
.btn-primary:hover{opacity:.85}
.btn-ghost{padding:9px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:.72rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}

/* 2D FALLBACK */
#view2d{position:fixed;inset:0;top:52px;background:var(--bg);overflow-y:auto;display:none;z-index:60;padding:1.5rem}
.v2d-inner{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto}
.v2d-inner h2{font-family:var(--font);font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.15em;margin-bottom:1.2rem;color:var(--text)}
.v2d-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:1rem}
.v2d-card{border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--dark);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s;overflow:hidden}
.v2d-card:hover{border-color:rgba(201,168,76,.4)}
.v2d-card-vid{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;background:#000}
.v2d-card-body{padding:.85rem 1rem}
.v2d-card-cat{font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.3rem}
.v2d-card-name{font-family:var(--font);font-size:.95rem;margin-bottom:.25rem}
.v2d-card-price{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.v2d-card-specs{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6}

/* NOTIFS */
#notifs{position:fixed;bottom:1.2rem;right:1.2rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column-reverse;gap:6px;z-index:70;pointer-events:none}
.notif{background:rgba(10,11,20,.96);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:3px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:.73rem;color:var(--text);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;opacity:0;transform:translateX(8px)}

/* LABELS */
.prod-lbl{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:18;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.prod-lbl.show{opacity:1}
.prod-lbl-inner{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(201,168,76,.8);background:rgba(6,7,13,.8);padding:2px 8px;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.15);white-space:nowrap;font-family:var(--sans)}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  #overlay,#hint,.notif,.prod-lbl{transition:none}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<nav id="nav">
  <div class="nav-brand"><span>PRISM</span></div>
  <div class="nav-tag">3D Product Gallery</div>
  <button class="nbtn" id="btn-reset">⌂ Reset View</button>
  <button class="nbtn" id="btn-2d" style="margin-left:.5rem">2D Gallery</button>
</nav>

<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<div id="labels"></div>

<div id="tooltip">
  <div class="tip-inner">
    <div class="tip-name" id="tip-name">—</div>
    <div class="tip-sub" id="tip-sub">hover to preview</div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="hint">Drag vitrinas · Hover to preview · Click to watch</div>

<div id="notifs"></div>

<!-- VIDEO OVERLAY -->
<div id="overlay">
  <div id="ov-box">
    <div class="ov-left">
      <div class="ov-head">
        <div><div class="ov-cat" id="ov-cat">Audio</div><div class="ov-title" id="ov-title">Aura Pro X</div></div>
        <button class="ov-close" id="ov-close">✕</button>
      </div>
      <canvas id="vid-canvas"></canvas>
      <div class="sub-bar"><div id="sub-text"></div></div>
      <div class="vid-ctrls">
        <div class="prog-track" id="prog-track"><div class="prog-fill" id="prog-fill"></div></div>
        <div class="ctrl-row">
          <button class="ctrl-btn" id="v-prev">⏮</button>
          <button class="ctrl-btn" id="v-play">▶</button>
          <button class="ctrl-btn" id="v-next">⏭</button>
          <span class="vid-time" id="v-time">0:00 / 0:00</span>
          <button class="cc-btn on" id="v-cc">CC</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="chap-strip" id="chap-strip"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="ov-right">
      <div class="spec-hero">
        <div class="spec-price" id="sp-price">$349</div>
        <div class="spec-tagline" id="sp-tagline">Concert Hall in Your Ears</div>
      </div>
      <div class="spec-list" id="sp-list"></div>
      <div class="spec-foot">
        <button class="btn-primary">Add to Cart</button>
        <button class="btn-ghost">♡</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- 2D FALLBACK -->
<div id="view2d">
  <div class="v2d-inner">
    <h2>Product Gallery</h2>
    <div class="v2d-grid" id="v2d-grid"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

// ─── PRODUCTS DATA ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const PRODUCTS = [
  {
    id:'P1', name:'Aura Pro X', cat:'Premium Audio', price:'$349', tagline:'Concert Hall in Your Ears',
    color:'#818cf8', colorHex:0x818cf8, model:'headphones',
    pos:[-4.5,0,0], dur:45,
    specs:['40mm Dynamic Drivers','30h Battery Life','Adaptive ANC — 40dB','Bluetooth 5.3 + aptX Lossless','Foldable Aerospace Aluminum'],
    chapters:[{t:'Sound',s:0},{t:'Design',s:15},{t:'Connect',s:30},{t:'Compare',s:40}],
    subs:[
      {s:0,e:13,t:'40mm dynamic drivers — tuned in concert halls, not labs.'},
      {s:13,e:26,t:'Aerospace-grade aluminum. Built for decades of music.'},
      {s:26,e:38,t:'Bluetooth 5.3 with aptX Lossless — wire quality, wirelessly.'},
      {s:38,e:45,t:'Aura Pro X. The last headphones you will ever need.'},
    ],
  },
  {
    id:'P2', name:'NexWatch S2', cat:'Wearable Tech', price:'$499', tagline:'Your Life, Elevated',
    color:'#f59e0b', colorHex:0xf59e0b, model:'watch',
    pos:[0,0,0.5], dur:38,
    specs:['Always-on AMOLED 2.1"','7-day Battery Endurance','ECG + SpO₂ + GPS','Titanium Grade-5 Case','50m Water Resistance'],
    chapters:[{t:'Health',s:0},{t:'Design',s:14},{t:'Endure',s:28}],
    subs:[
      {s:0,e:12,t:'ECG, blood oxygen, sleep — your health command center.'},
      {s:12,e:24,t:'Grade-5 titanium. Sapphire crystal. Precision at your wrist.'},
      {s:24,e:38,t:'7 days on a single charge. Through every adventure.'},
    ],
  },
  {
    id:'P3', name:'CrystalPad Pro', cat:'Tablet', price:'$899', tagline:'Create Without Limits',
    color:'#38bdf8', colorHex:0x38bdf8, model:'tablet',
    pos:[4.5,0,0], dur:42,
    specs:['13" OLED 120Hz ProMotion','M4 Silicon — 15-core GPU','512GB NVMe Storage','Apple Pencil Pro Support','12h Pro Workload Battery'],
    chapters:[{t:'Display',s:0},{t:'Power',s:14},{t:'Create',s:28},{t:'Carry',s:36}],
    subs:[
      {s:0,e:12,t:'1,000,000:1 contrast ratio. Every pixel, deliberate.'},
      {s:12,e:24,t:'M4 chip — faster than most laptops. Smaller than your notebook.'},
      {s:24,e:36,t:'The pen feels like paper. The canvas is infinite.'},
      {s:36,e:42,t:'Pro power. Zero compromise.'},
    ],
  },
  {
    id:'P4', name:'SonicBeam 360', cat:'Portable Audio', price:'$249', tagline:'Sound Surrounds You',
    color:'#34d399', colorHex:0x34d399, model:'speaker',
    pos:[-4.5,0,-5.5], dur:36,
    specs:['360° Omnidirectional Sound','Dual 3" Woofer + 4 Tweeters','24h Playtime IP68','Multi-room WiFi Sync','Lossless Hi-Res Audio'],
    chapters:[{t:'Sound',s:0},{t:'Build',s:14},{t:'Sync',s:26}],
    subs:[
      {s:0,e:12,t:'360-degree sound that fills any space — room, rooftop, or rainforest.'},
      {s:12,e:24,t:'IP68 rated. Fully dustproof. Fully waterproof. Fully you.'},
      {s:24,e:36,t:'Multi-room sync. Every speaker, one heartbeat.'},
    ],
  },
  {
    id:'P5', name:'VisionAR One', cat:'Augmented Reality', price:'$1,299', tagline:'See Beyond Reality',
    color:'#f472b6', colorHex:0xf472b6, model:'glasses',
    pos:[0,0,-5.5], dur:50,
    specs:['Dual Micro-OLED 4K/eye','120° Field of View','Real-time Spatial Mapping','8-core On-device NPU','All-day Battery + Case'],
    chapters:[{t:'Vision',s:0},{t:'Space',s:16},{t:'AI',s:32},{t:'Future',s:44}],
    subs:[
      {s:0,e:14,t:'Dual micro-OLED at 4K per eye. Your world, augmented.'},
      {s:14,e:28,t:'120° field of view. Spatial mapping at 60fps.'},
      {s:28,e:40,t:'On-device AI inference — no cloud, no latency, ever.'},
      {s:40,e:50,t:'VisionAR One. The future arrived early.'},
    ],
  },
  {
    id:'P6', name:'FluxDrive X1', cat:'Storage', price:'$179', tagline:'Speed Redefined',
    color:'#06b6d4', colorHex:0x06b6d4, model:'ssd',
    pos:[4.5,0,-5.5], dur:32,
    specs:['7,400MB/s Read Speed','2TB NVMe PCIe 5.0','Shock-resistant IP55','AES-256 Encryption','USB-C 40Gbps + Thunderbolt'],
    chapters:[{t:'Speed',s:0},{t:'Capacity',s:12},{t:'Security',s:24}],
    subs:[
      {s:0,e:10,t:'7,400 megabytes per second. Your workflow, unchained.'},
      {s:10,e:22,t:'2TB of NVMe. Take your entire studio with you.'},
      {s:22,e:32,t:'AES-256 encryption. Your data is yours — always.'},
    ],
  },
];

// GRID SLOTS for snap-to
const SLOTS = PRODUCTS.map(p=>[...p.pos]);

// ─── RENDERER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const canvas3d = document.getElementById('c');
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas:canvas3d, antialias:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio,2));
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
renderer.toneMappingExposure = 0.85;

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x06070d);
scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x06070d, 0.038);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, 1, 0.1, 60);
camera.position.set(0, 4, 12);

const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, canvas3d);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.dampingFactor = 0.07;
controls.target.set(0, 1.2, -2);
controls.minDistance = 3;
controls.maxDistance = 22;
controls.maxPolarAngle = Math.PI*.47;

// ─── LIGHTS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x0a0b14, 6));
const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x1a1c2e, 0x050710, 1.2);
scene.add(hemi);

// ─── FLOOR ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function makeFloor() {
  const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=512; c.height=512;
  const ctx=c.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle='#080a12'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,512,512);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(201,168,76,0.07)'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let i=0;i<=512;i+=64){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(i,0);ctx.lineTo(i,512);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,i);ctx.lineTo(512,i);ctx.stroke();
  }
  const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  t.wrapS=t.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping; t.repeat.set(8,8);
  return t;
}
const floor=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(32,32),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({map:makeFloor(),roughness:.5,metalness:.3}));
floor.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2; floor.receiveShadow=true;
floor.position.set(0,-.01,-3); scene.add(floor);

// ─── PRODUCT MODELS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function makeProduct(type, col) {
  const grp=new THREE.Group();
  const c=new THREE.Color(col);
  const mat=(ex={})=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:c,metalness:.72,roughness:.25,...ex});

  if(type==='headphones') {
    const band=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.38,.042,10,40,Math.PI),mat());
    band.rotation.z=Math.PI; band.position.y=.44; grp.add(band);
    [-1,1].forEach(s=>{
      const cup=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.16,.16,.1,24),mat());
      cup.rotation.z=Math.PI/2; cup.position.set(s*.38,0,0); grp.add(cup);
      const inner=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.12,.12,.04,24),
        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x12141e,metalness:.2,roughness:.8}));
      inner.rotation.z=Math.PI/2; inner.position.set(s*.44,0,0); grp.add(inner);
    });
  }
  else if(type==='watch') {
    const body=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.24,.24,.09,8),mat({metalness:.9}));
    grp.add(body);
    const scr=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.21,.21,.005,8),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x0a1030}));
    scr.position.y=.048; grp.add(scr);
    const bm=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x1a1a1a,roughness:.95,metalness:.05});
    const bt=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.15,.52,.055),bm);
    bt.position.y=-.32; grp.add(bt);
    const bb=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.15,.44,.055),bm);
    bb.position.y=.29; grp.add(bb);
  }
  else if(type==='tablet') {
    const body=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.88,.055,1.18),mat({metalness:.8}));
    grp.add(body);
    const scr=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(.82,1.1),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x0a1020}));
    scr.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2; scr.position.y=.03; grp.add(scr);
  }
  else if(type==='speaker') {
    const body=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.28,.28,.72,24),mat());
    grp.add(body);
    [-.18,0,.18].forEach(y=>{
      const ring=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.28,.013,6,32),
        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x181820,metalness:.4,roughness:.7}));
      ring.rotation.x=Math.PI/2; ring.position.y=y; grp.add(ring);
    });
    const top=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.07,.07,.07,12),mat({metalness:.9}));
    top.position.y=.41; grp.add(top);
  }
  else if(type==='glasses') {
    [-1,1].forEach(s=>{
      const frame=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.18,.022,8,32),mat());
      frame.position.x=s*.23; grp.add(frame);
      const lens=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(.16,32),
        new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x1a0a22,transparent:true,opacity:.75}));
      lens.position.set(s*.23,0,.002); grp.add(lens);
    });
    const bridge=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.009,.009,.1,8),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:col,metalness:.8,roughness:.2}));
    bridge.rotation.z=Math.PI/2; grp.add(bridge);
    [-1,1].forEach(s=>{
      const tm=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.38,.012,.01),
        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:col,metalness:.7,roughness:.3}));
      tm.position.set(s*.41,0,-.08); tm.rotation.y=s*-.15; grp.add(tm);
    });
  }
  else if(type==='ssd') {
    const body=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.02,.082,.62),mat({metalness:.8,roughness:.3}));
    grp.add(body);
    const conn=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.2,.08,.09),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xd4a843,metalness:.9,roughness:.12}));
    conn.position.set(-.42,0,0); grp.add(conn);
    const led=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.02,8,8),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:col}));
    led.position.set(.42,.046,0); grp.add(led);
  }
  return grp;
}

// ─── SPECS CANVAS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function makeSpecsTex(p) {
  const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=400; c.height=640;
  const ctx=c.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle='#08090e'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,400,640);
  ctx.fillStyle=p.color; ctx.fillRect(0,0,400,4);
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,110);
  g.addColorStop(0,p.color+'44'); g.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,400,110);
  ctx.font='bold 13px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
  ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.textBaseline='top';
  ctx.fillText(p.cat.toUpperCase(), 26, 28);
  ctx.font='italic 38px Georgia,serif'; ctx.fillStyle='#e8e4dc';
  ctx.fillText(p.name, 26, 54);
  ctx.font='300 15px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(232,228,220,.45)';
  ctx.fillText(p.tagline, 26, 100);
  ctx.fillStyle=p.color+'55'; ctx.fillRect(26,124,348,1);
  p.specs.forEach((s,i)=>{
    const y=148+i*48;
    ctx.font='12px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle=p.color+'99'; ctx.fillText('◆',26,y);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(232,228,220,.82)'; ctx.fillText(s,46,y);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.05)'; ctx.fillRect(26,y+20,348,1);
  });
  ctx.font='bold 30px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
  ctx.textAlign='right'; ctx.textBaseline='bottom';
  ctx.fillText(p.price, 374, 630);
  ctx.font='12px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(232,228,220,.35)';
  ctx.fillText('Starting from', 374,612);
  return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
}

// ─── BUILD CASES ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const cases=[]; // {grp, product, hitbox, product3d, spot, glassMats}
const hitboxes=[];

function makeCase(p) {
  const grp=new THREE.Group();
  grp.position.set(...p.pos);
  scene.add(grp);

  const W=2.2, H=2.8, D=2.2;
  const col=new THREE.Color(p.color);

  // Platform
  const platMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:col,metalness:.5,roughness:.4,transparent:true,opacity:.18});
  const plat=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(W-.1,.1,D-.1),platMat);
  plat.position.y=.05; grp.add(plat);
  const platTop=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(W-.1,.03,D-.1),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:col,metalness:.8,roughness:.15,transparent:true,opacity:.4}));
  platTop.position.y=.115; grp.add(platTop);

  // Glass walls (4 sides + ceil)
  const glassMat=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x6688cc,transparent:true,opacity:.08,side:THREE.DoubleSide,depthWrite:false});
  const glassMats=[];
  const wallConfigs=[
    [W,H, 0,H/2+.05, D/2,  0],
    [W,H, 0,H/2+.05,-D/2,  Math.PI],
    [D,H,-W/2,H/2+.05,0,   Math.PI/2],
    [D,H, W/2,H/2+.05,0,  -Math.PI/2],
    [W,D,  0, H+.1,   0,   0], // ceiling
  ];
  wallConfigs.forEach(([w,h,x,y,z,ry])=>{
    const m=glassMat.clone();
    const wall=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w,h),m);
    wall.position.set(x,y,z); wall.rotation.y=ry;
    if(Math.abs(ry)===0&&z===0){wall.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;} // ceiling
    grp.add(wall); glassMats.push(m);
  });

  // Gold frame edges
  const boxGeo=new THREE.BoxGeometry(W,H,D);
  const edges=new THREE.EdgesGeometry(boxGeo);
  const edgeLine=new THREE.LineSegments(edges,
    new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:0xc9a84c,transparent:true,opacity:.55}));
  edgeLine.position.y=H/2+.1;
  grp.add(edgeLine);

  // Specs panel (back inner wall)
  const specsTex=makeSpecsTex(p);
  const specsPanel=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(W-.15,H-.1),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:specsTex,transparent:true}));
  specsPanel.position.set(0,H/2+.1,-D/2+.04);
  grp.add(specsPanel);

  // Product 3D model
  const prod=makeProduct(p.model, p.color);
  prod.position.y=1.1;
  grp.add(prod);

  // Spotlight
  const spot=new THREE.SpotLight(col, 2.5, 7, Math.PI/7, 0.5);
  spot.position.set(0, H+.3, 0);
  spot.castShadow=true;
  spot.shadow.mapSize.set(256,256);
  grp.add(spot); grp.add(spot.target);
  spot.target.position.set(0,0,0);

  // Invisible hitbox
  const hit=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(W+.2,H+.5,D+.2),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({visible:false}));
  hit.position.y=H/2+.1;
  hit.userData.caseId=p.id;
  grp.add(hit); hitboxes.push(hit);

  // Underlight
  const ul=new THREE.PointLight(col, .8, 3);
  ul.position.set(0,.2,0);
  grp.add(ul);

  cases.push({grp, product:p, hitbox:hit, prod3d:prod, spot, glassMats, edgeLine, platTop, ul, _basePos:[...p.pos]});
}

PRODUCTS.forEach(makeCase);

// ─── RAYCASTER + HOVER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const ray=new THREE.Raycaster();
const mouse=new THREE.Vector2();
let hoveredCase=null, hintGone=false;

const tooltip=document.getElementById('tooltip');

canvas3d.addEventListener('mousemove', e=>{
  if(dragging) return;
  const r=canvas3d.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.set(((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*2-1, -((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height)*2+1);
  ray.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);
  const hits=ray.intersectObjects(hitboxes);
  const newHover=hits.length?cases.find(c=>c.product.id===hits[0].object.userData.caseId):null;

  if(newHover!==hoveredCase) {
    if(hoveredCase) {
      // de-highlight
      gsap.to(hoveredCase.grp.scale,{x:1,y:1,z:1,duration:.2});
      hoveredCase.spot.intensity=2.5;
      hoveredCase.glassMats.forEach(m=>m.opacity=.08);
    }
    if(newHover) {
      // highlight
      gsap.to(newHover.grp.scale,{x:1.03,y:1.03,z:1.03,duration:.2,ease:'back.out(1.5)'});
      newHover.spot.intensity=5;
      newHover.glassMats.forEach(m=>m.opacity=.14);
      document.getElementById('tip-name').textContent=newHover.product.name;
      document.getElementById('tip-sub').textContent=newHover.product.cat+' · '+newHover.product.price;
      tooltip.style.color=newHover.product.color;
    }
    hoveredCase=newHover;
    canvas3d.style.cursor=newHover?'pointer':'default';
  }

  if(hoveredCase) {
    tooltip.style.left=e.clientX+'px';
    tooltip.style.top=(e.clientY-14)+'px';
    tooltip.style.opacity='1';
  } else {
    tooltip.style.opacity='0';
  }
});

// ─── DRAG TO REORGANIZE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let dragging=null;
const dragPlane=new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),0);
const dragPt=new THREE.Vector3();

canvas3d.addEventListener('mousedown', e=>{
  const r=canvas3d.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.set(((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*2-1,-((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height)*2+1);
  ray.setFromCamera(mouse,camera);
  const hits=ray.intersectObjects(hitboxes);
  if(hits.length&&e.button===0){
    const c=cases.find(x=>x.product.id===hits[0].object.userData.caseId);
    if(c){ dragging=c; controls.enabled=false; canvas3d.style.cursor='grabbing';
      if(!hintGone){document.getElementById('hint').classList.add('gone');hintGone=true;}
    }
  }
});

window.addEventListener('mousemove', e=>{
  if(!dragging)return;
  const r=canvas3d.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.set(((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*2-1,-((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height)*2+1);
  ray.setFromCamera(mouse,camera);
  ray.ray.intersectPlane(dragPlane,dragPt);
  dragging.grp.position.x=dragPt.x;
  dragging.grp.position.z=dragPt.z;
});

window.addEventListener('mouseup', ()=>{
  if(!dragging)return;
  // Find nearest slot (excluding slots already occupied)
  let best=null, bestD=Infinity;
  SLOTS.forEach(slot=>{
    const d=Math.hypot(dragging.grp.position.x-slot[0], dragging.grp.position.z-slot[2]);
    if(d<bestD){bestD=d;best=slot;}
  });
  if(best){
    gsap.to(dragging.grp.position,{x:best[0],z:best[2],y:0,duration:.45,ease:'back.out(1.6)'});
  }
  controls.enabled=true;
  canvas3d.style.cursor='default';
  dragging=null;
  tooltip.style.opacity='0';
  showNotif('📦 Vitrina reordenada');
});

// ─── CAMERA FLY-TO ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let flying=false;
function flyTo(cp,tgt,dur=1.6,cb){
  if(flying)return;
  flying=true; controls.enabled=false;
  const sc=camera.position.clone(), st=controls.target.clone();
  const ec=new THREE.Vector3(...cp), et=new THREE.Vector3(...tgt);
  const px={t:0};
  gsap.to(px,{t:1,duration:dur,ease:'power3.inOut',
    onUpdate(){camera.position.lerpVectors(sc,ec,px.t);controls.target.lerpVectors(st,et,px.t);},
    onComplete(){flying=false;controls.enabled=true;if(cb)cb();}
  });
}
function flyHome(){flyTo([0,4,12],[0,1.2,-2],1.4);}

// ─── CLICK → OVERLAY ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
canvas3d.addEventListener('click', e=>{
  if(dragging||flying)return;
  const r=canvas3d.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.set(((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*2-1,-((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height)*2+1);
  ray.setFromCamera(mouse,camera);
  const hits=ray.intersectObjects(hitboxes);
  if(hits.length){
    const p=PRODUCTS.find(x=>x.id===hits[0].object.userData.caseId);
    if(p) openProduct(p);
  }
});

let activeProduct=null;

function openProduct(p) {
  activeProduct=p;
  document.getElementById('ov-cat').textContent=p.cat;
  document.getElementById('ov-title').textContent=p.name;
  document.getElementById('sp-price').textContent=p.price;
  document.getElementById('sp-price').style.color=p.color;
  document.getElementById('sp-tagline').textContent=p.tagline;
  document.getElementById('sp-list').innerHTML=p.specs.map(s=>`
    <div class="spec-item">
      <div class="spec-gem" style="background:${p.color}"></div>
      <div class="spec-txt">${s}</div>
    </div>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('prog-fill').style.background=p.color;
  document.getElementById('chap-strip').innerHTML=p.chapters.map((c,i)=>
    `<button class="chap-btn" data-i="${i}">${c.t}</button>`).join('');
  document.querySelectorAll('.chap-btn').forEach(b=>{
    b.addEventListener('click',()=>{vidProg=p.chapters[+b.dataset.i].s;updateVidUI();});
  });
  vidDur=p.dur; vidProg=0; vidPlaying=false;
  updateVidUI();
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.add('open');
  // fly near case
  const [px,py,pz]=p.pos;
  flyTo([px+2.5,py+2.5,pz+5.5],[px,py+1.4,pz],1.5,()=>playVid());
  showNotif(`${p.name} · ${p.cat}`);
}

function closeOverlay(){
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('open');
  stopVid(); activeProduct=null;
  flyHome();
}
document.getElementById('ov-close').addEventListener('click',closeOverlay);

// ─── VIDEO PLAYER (canvas-based mock) ────────────────────────────────────────
const vidCanvas=document.getElementById('vid-canvas');
const vidCtx=vidCanvas.getContext('2d');
vidCanvas.width=640; vidCanvas.height=360;

let vidDur=45, vidProg=0, vidPlaying=false, vidRaf=null, vidLast=null;
let ccOn=true, curChap=0;

function getSub(subs,t){return subs.find(s=>t>=s.s&&t<s.e)?.t||'';}
function fmtT(s){return `${Math.floor(s/60)}:${Math.floor(s%60).toString().padStart(2,'0')}`;}

function drawVidFrame() {
  if(!activeProduct)return;
  const p=activeProduct, ctx=vidCtx, cw=640, ch=360;
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,ch);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#05060d'); g.addColorStop(1,'#080a12');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,cw,ch);
  // grid
  ctx.strokeStyle=p.color+'10'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let x=0;x<cw;x+=54){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x,ch);ctx.stroke();}
  for(let y=0;y<ch;y+=48){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(cw,y);ctx.stroke();}
  // scan
  ctx.fillStyle=p.color+'14'; ctx.fillRect(0,(vidProg*28)%ch,cw,2);
  // chapter name
  const chap=activeProduct.chapters[curChap];
  if(chap){
    ctx.font='bold 11px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle=p.color+'99';
    ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.textBaseline='top';
    ctx.fillText(chap.t.toUpperCase(), 20, 20);
  }
  // product name
  ctx.font='italic 28px Georgia,serif'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(232,228,220,.95)';
  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText(p.name,cw/2,ch/2-30);
  // color stripe
  const sw=200*(0.4+Math.sin(vidProg*.4)*.6);
  ctx.fillStyle=p.color+'80'; ctx.fillRect(cw/2-sw/2,ch/2-4,sw,2);
  // category
  ctx.font='600 12px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle=p.color+'cc';
  ctx.fillText(p.cat, cw/2, ch/2+15);
  // progress arc
  const cx=cw/2, cy=ch/2+65, r=26;
  ctx.strokeStyle=p.color+'22'; ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle=p.color; ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,-Math.PI/2,-Math.PI/2+(vidProg/vidDur)*Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.font='bold 10px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle=p.color+'ee'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText(Math.round((vidProg/vidDur)*100)+'%',cx,cy);
  // bottom bar
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.4)'; ctx.fillRect(0,ch-10,cw,10);
  ctx.fillStyle=p.color; ctx.fillRect(0,ch-10,(vidProg/vidDur)*cw,10);
  ctx.font='9px monospace'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.5)'; ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillText(fmtT(vidProg),cw-8,ch-1);
}

function updateVidUI(){
  const pct=vidDur?(vidProg/vidDur)*100:0;
  document.getElementById('prog-fill').style.width=pct+'%';
  document.getElementById('v-time').textContent=`${fmtT(vidProg)} / ${fmtT(vidDur)}`;
  document.getElementById('v-play').textContent=vidPlaying?'⏸':'▶';
  if(activeProduct){
    const c=activeProduct.chapters; let ci=0;
    for(let i=0;i<c.length;i++){if(vidProg>=c[i].s)ci=i;}
    curChap=ci;
    document.querySelectorAll('.chap-btn').forEach((el,i)=>el.classList.toggle('active',i===ci));
    document.getElementById('sub-text').textContent=ccOn?getSub(activeProduct.subs,vidProg):'';
  }
  drawVidFrame();
}

function playVid(){
  if(!vidPlaying){if(vidProg>=vidDur)vidProg=0;vidPlaying=true;vidLast=performance.now();
    const tick=now=>{if(!vidPlaying)return;const dt=(now-vidLast)/1000;vidLast=now;vidProg=Math.min(vidProg+dt,vidDur);if(vidProg>=vidDur)vidPlaying=false;updateVidUI();vidRaf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);};
    vidRaf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
}
function pauseVid(){vidPlaying=false;}
function stopVid(){vidPlaying=false;vidProg=0;if(vidRaf)cancelAnimationFrame(vidRaf);}
function prevChap(){if(!activeProduct)return;const c=activeProduct.chapters;vidProg=c[Math.max(0,curChap-1)].s;updateVidUI();}
function nextChap(){if(!activeProduct)return;const c=activeProduct.chapters;vidProg=c[Math.min(curChap+1,c.length-1)].s;updateVidUI();}

document.getElementById('v-play').addEventListener('click',()=>{vidPlaying?pauseVid():playVid();updateVidUI();});
document.getElementById('v-prev').addEventListener('click',prevChap);
document.getElementById('v-next').addEventListener('click',nextChap);
document.getElementById('v-cc').addEventListener('click',()=>{ccOn=!ccOn;document.getElementById('v-cc').classList.toggle('on',ccOn);updateVidUI();});

const progTrack=document.getElementById('prog-track');
let scrubbing=false;
function scrubAt(cx){const r=progTrack.getBoundingClientRect();vidProg=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(cx-r.left)/r.width))*vidDur;updateVidUI();}
progTrack.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{scrubbing=true;scrubAt(e.clientX);});
window.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{if(scrubbing)scrubAt(e.clientX);});
window.addEventListener('mouseup',()=>{scrubbing=false;});

// ─── 2D FALLBACK ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function build2d() {
  const grid=document.getElementById('v2d-grid');
  grid.innerHTML=PRODUCTS.map(p=>{
    const c=document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width=400; c.height=225; c.id='v2d-c-'+p.id;
    // Draw preview immediately
    const ctx=c.getContext('2d');
    const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,225);
    g.addColorStop(0,'#06070d'); g.addColorStop(1,'#0a0b16');
    ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,400,225);
    ctx.fillStyle=p.color+'22'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,400,225);
    ctx.font='italic 32px Georgia,serif'; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(232,228,220,.9)';
    ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillText(p.name,200,95);
    ctx.font='12px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
    ctx.fillText(p.cat.toUpperCase(),200,130);
    ctx.font='bold 22px system-ui'; ctx.fillStyle=p.color;
    ctx.fillText(p.price,200,165);
    const dataUrl=c.toDataURL();
    return `<div class="v2d-card" onclick="document.getElementById('btn-2d').click()">
      <img class="v2d-card-vid" src="${dataUrl}" alt="${p.name}"/>
      <div class="v2d-card-body">
        <div class="v2d-card-cat" style="color:${p.color}">${p.cat}</div>
        <div class="v2d-card-name">${p.name}</div>
        <div class="v2d-card-price" style="color:${p.color}">${p.price}</div>
        <div class="v2d-card-specs">${p.specs.slice(0,3).join(' · ')}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}
build2d();

let is2d=false;
document.getElementById('btn-2d').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  is2d=!is2d;
  document.getElementById('view2d').style.display=is2d?'block':'none';
  document.getElementById('btn-2d').textContent=is2d?'3D View':'2D Gallery';
  document.getElementById('btn-2d').classList.toggle('active',is2d);
});
document.getElementById('btn-reset').addEventListener('click',()=>{closeOverlay();showNotif('🔭 View reset');});

// ─── LABELS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const labelsDiv=document.getElementById('labels');
const labelEls={};
PRODUCTS.forEach(p=>{
  const el=document.createElement('div');
  el.className='prod-lbl';
  el.innerHTML=`<div class="prod-lbl-inner">${p.name}</div>`;
  labelsDiv.appendChild(el);
  labelEls[p.id]=el;
});
setTimeout(()=>{document.querySelectorAll('.prod-lbl').forEach(el=>el.classList.add('show'));},1200);

const _v=new THREE.Vector3();
function updateLabels(){
  cases.forEach(c=>{
    _v.set(c.grp.position.x,c.grp.position.y+3.1,c.grp.position.z).project(camera);
    const x=(_v.x*.5+.5)*canvas3d.clientWidth;
    const y=(-_v.y*.5+.5)*canvas3d.clientHeight+52;
    const el=labelEls[c.product.id];
    if(el&&_v.z<1){el.style.display='block';el.style.left=x+'px';el.style.top=y+'px';}
    else if(el) el.style.display='none';
  });
}

// ─── NOTIFICATIONS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function showNotif(msg){
  const el=document.createElement('div'); el.className='notif'; el.textContent=msg;
  document.getElementById('notifs').appendChild(el);
  gsap.to(el,{opacity:1,x:0,duration:.28,ease:'back.out(1.4)'});
  setTimeout(()=>{gsap.to(el,{opacity:0,x:6,duration:.22,onComplete:()=>el.remove()});},2600);
}

// ─── RESIZE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function resize(){
  const w=window.innerWidth,h=window.innerHeight;
  renderer.setSize(w,h); camera.aspect=w/h; camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
resize(); window.addEventListener('resize',resize);

// ─── RENDER LOOP ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const clock=new THREE.Clock();
function animate(){
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  const t=clock.getElapsedTime();
  controls.update();

  // Product & case animations
  cases.forEach((c,i)=>{
    const speed=hoveredCase===c?2.2:0.5;
    c.prod3d.rotation.y+=speed*0.01;
    // subtle floating
    c.prod3d.position.y=1.1+Math.sin(t*.9+i*1.1)*.05;
    // underlight pulse
    c.ul.intensity=.7+Math.sin(t*1.4+i)*.35;
    // spot color pulse on hover
    if(hoveredCase===c) c.spot.intensity=4.5+Math.sin(t*3)*.8;
  });

  // Proximity preview: glow up nearby cases
  cases.forEach(c=>{
    const d=camera.position.distanceTo(c.grp.position);
    if(d<6&&hoveredCase!==c){
      c.glassMats.forEach(m=>m.opacity=.1+(.06*(1-d/6)));
    }
  });

  updateLabels();
  renderer.render(scene,camera);
}
animate();

// ─── KEYBOARD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.key==='Escape')closeOverlay();
  if(e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();vidPlaying?pauseVid():playVid();updateVidUI();}
  if(e.key==='ArrowRight')nextChap();
  if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')prevChap();
});

setTimeout(()=>showNotif('🖱 Arrastra las vitrinas · Click para ver el video'),900);
</script>
</body>
</html>

- **Hover** → escala 1.03 + spotlight se duplica + tooltip con nombre y precio + glass se aclara
- **Drag** → arrastra cualquier vitrina por el suelo (plano XZ) y suelta → snap GSAP al slot más cercano con `back.out`
- **Click** → fly-to a la vitrina + overlay split con video canvas a la izquierda + specs a la derecha
- **Proximidad** → cuando la cámara se acerca (<6m), el vidrio se aclara gradualmente

**Video overlay:** canvas procedural con progress arc, scan lines, capítulos, CC y subtítulos sincronizados por segundo

**2D Gallery:** grid de thumbnails generados desde canvas con imagen, categoría, precio y specs

**Accesibilidad:** `prefers-reduced-motion`, `Esc/Space/←/→`, etiquetas de nombre flotantes sobre cada vitrina
